+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
+from typing import TextIO
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NoteStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".notes.json")
+
+
+def _format_note_line(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"{note.id}\t{note.created_at}\t{note.title}"
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A tiny command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        default=os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE", DEFAULT_PATH),
+        help="path to the notes JSON file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title", help="note title")
+    p_add.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="search notes by text")
+    p_search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+# Each handler takes (store, args, out) and returns nothing.
+def _cmd_add(store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+    print(f"Added note {note.id}.", file=out)
+
+
+def _print_notes(notes: list[Note], out: TextIO, empty_msg: str) -> None:
+    if not notes:
+        print(empty_msg, file=out)
+    for note in notes:
+        print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_list(store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    _print_notes(store.list_all(), out, "No notes.")
+
+
+def _cmd_show(store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    note = store.get(args.id)
+    print(f"#{note.id}  {note.title}", file=out)
+    print(f"created: {note.created_at}", file=out)
+    if note.body:
+        print("", file=out)
+        print(note.body, file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_delete(store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    note = store.delete(args.id)
+    print(f"Deleted note {note.id}.", file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_search(store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    _print_notes(store.search(args.query), out, "No matches.")
+
+
+HANDLERS: dict[str, Callable[[NoteStore, argparse.Namespace, TextIO], None]] = {
+    "add": _cmd_add,
+    "list": _cmd_list,
+    "show": _cmd_show,
+    "delete": _cmd_delete,
+    "search": _cmd_search,
+}
+
+
+def main(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    stdout: TextIO | None = None,
+    stderr: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Run the CLI and return a process exit code."""
+    out = stdout if stdout is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = stderr if stderr is not None else sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+    store = NoteStore(args.file)
+
+    try:
+        HANDLERS[args.command](store, args, out)
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: note {args.id} not found", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0

+"""JSON-file-backed storage for notes."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created_at: str
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
+        """Serialize to a plain dict suitable for JSON."""
+        return asdict(self)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, data: dict) -> "Note":
+        """Build a Note from a dict produced by ``to_dict``."""
+        return cls(
+            id=int(data["id"]),
+            title=str(data["title"]),
+            body=str(data.get("body", "")),
+            created_at=str(data["created_at"]),
+        )
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """Persists notes to a JSON file. Missing files are treated as empty."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Read all notes from disk; a missing file yields an empty list."""
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note.from_dict(item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        """Atomically write ``notes`` to disk."""
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the store.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([n.to_dict() for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        """Create a note. Raises ValueError if the title is blank."""
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        note = Note(
+            id=next_id,
+            title=title,
+            body=body,
+            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list_all(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return all notes sorted by id."""
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Return the note with ``note_id``. Raises NoteNotFoundError if absent."""
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Remove and return the note with ``note_id``. Raises NoteNotFoundError if absent."""
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                del notes[i]
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return notes whose title or body contains ``query`` (case-insensitive)."""
+        needle = query.lower()
+        return [
+            n
+            for n in self.list_all()
+            if needle in n.title.lower() or needle in n.body.lower()
+        ]

+"""Simple gradebook for tracking student scores on assignments.
+
+Example:
+    >>> book = Gradebook()
+    >>> book.add_student("s1", "Ada Lovelace")
+    >>> book.add_assignment("a1", "Quiz 1", max_points=10)
+    >>> book.record_score("s1", "a1", 9)
+    >>> book.percentage("s1")
+    90.0
+    >>> book.letter_grade("s1")
+    'A'
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+DEFAULT_GRADE_SCALE: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(Exception):
+    """Base error for gradebook operations."""
+
+
+class DuplicateError(GradebookError):
+    """Raised when adding a student or assignment whose ID already exists."""
+
+
+class NotFoundError(GradebookError):
+    """Raised when referring to an unknown student or assignment."""
+
+
+class InvalidScoreError(GradebookError):
+    """Raised when a score is out of range or not a number."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Student:
+    """A student enrolled in the gradebook."""
+
+    student_id: str
+    name: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    """An assignment with a maximum point value."""
+
+    assignment_id: str
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_points <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("max_points must be positive")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Gradebook:
+    """Tracks students, assignments, and their scores.
+
+    A score of ``None`` means the assignment has not been graded for that
+    student yet; ungraded assignments are excluded from averages.
+    """
+
+    grade_scale: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_GRADE_SCALE
+    _students: dict[str, Student] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _scores: dict[tuple[str, str], float | None] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    # --- students -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student_id: str, name: str) -> Student:
+        if student_id in self._students:
+            raise DuplicateError(f"student {student_id!r} already exists")
+        if not name or not name.strip():
+            raise ValueError("student name must not be empty")
+        student = Student(student_id, name.strip())
+        self._students[student_id] = student
+        return student
+
+    def students(self) -> list[Student]:
+        return sorted(self._students.values(), key=lambda s: s.name)
+
+    def remove_student(self, student_id: str) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        del self._students[student_id]
+        for key in [k for k in self._scores if k[0] == student_id]:
+            del self._scores[key]
+
+    # --- assignments --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_assignment(
+        self, assignment_id: str, name: str, max_points: float
+    ) -> Assignment:
+        if assignment_id in self._assignments:
+            raise DuplicateError(f"assignment {assignment_id!r} already exists")
+        if not name or not name.strip():
+            raise ValueError("assignment name must not be empty")
+        assignment = Assignment(assignment_id, name.strip(), float(max_points))
+        self._assignments[assignment_id] = assignment
+        return assignment
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    def remove_assignment(self, assignment_id: str) -> None:
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        del self._assignments[assignment_id]
+        for key in [k for k in self._scores if k[1] == assignment_id]:
+            del self._scores[key]
+
+    # --- scores -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(
+        self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str, points: float | None
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record points earned on an assignment. Pass ``None`` to clear a grade."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        if points is None:
+            self._scores[(student_id, assignment_id)] = None
+            return
+        if isinstance(points, bool) or not isinstance(points, (int, float)):
+            raise InvalidScoreError("points must be a number")
+        if points < 0 or points > assignment.max_points:
+            raise InvalidScoreError(
+                f"points must be between 0 and {assignment.max_points:g}, got {points:g}"
+            )
+        self._scores[(student_id, assignment_id)] = float(points)
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> float | None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        return self._scores.get((student_id, assignment_id))
+
+    # --- calculations -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def percentage(self, student_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Points earned divided by points possible over graded assignments.
+
+        Returns ``None`` if the student has no graded assignments yet.
+        """
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        earned = 0.0
+        possible = 0.0
+        for (sid, aid), points in self._scores.items():
+            if sid != student_id or points is None:
+                continue
+            earned += points
+            possible += self._assignments[aid].max_points
+        if possible == 0:
+            return None
+        return round(earned / possible * 100, 2)
+
+    def letter_grade(self, student_id: str) -> str | None:
+        pct = self.percentage(student_id)
+        if pct is None:
+            return None
+        return self.letter_for(pct)
+
+    def letter_for(self, percentage: float) -> str:
+        for threshold, letter in self.grade_scale:
+            if percentage >= threshold:
+                return letter
+        return self.grade_scale[-1][1]
+
+    def assignment_average(self, assignment_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Mean points earned on an assignment across graded students."""
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        graded = [
+            p
+            for (sid, aid), p in self._scores.items()
+            if aid == assignment_id and p is not None and sid in self._students
+        ]
+        if not graded:
+            return None
+        return round(sum(graded) / len(graded), 2)
+
+    def missing(self, assignment_id: str) -> list[Student]:
+        """Students with no score recorded for the given assignment."""
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        return [
+            s
+            for s in self.students()
+            if self._scores.get((s.student_id, assignment_id)) is None
+        ]
+
+    def report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+        """One row per student with percentage and letter grade, sorted by name."""
+        rows = []
+        for student in self.students():
+            pct = self.percentage(student.student_id)
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "student_id": student.student_id,
+                    "name": student.name,
+                    "percentage": pct,
+                    "letter": None if pct is None else self.letter_for(pct),
+                }
+            )
+        return rows
+
+    # --- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student_id: str) -> Student:
+        try:
+            return self._students[student_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown student {student_id!r}") from None
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, assignment_id: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self._assignments[assignment_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown assignment {assignment_id!r}") from None

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.notes import Note, NotesStore, NoteNotFoundError
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def default_path() -> Path:
+    """Notes file location: $NOTES_FILE if set, otherwise ~/.notes.json."""
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    return Path(env) if env else DEFAULT_PATH
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A simple command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title", help="note title")
+    p_add.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_edit = sub.add_parser("edit", help="change a note's title and/or body")
+    p_edit.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-t", "--title", default=None)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-b", "--body", default=None)
+
+    p_rm = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_rm.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_find = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p_find.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def _format_summary(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"[{note.id}] {note.title}  ({note.updated})"
+
+
+def _format_full(note: Note) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"#{note.id}: {note.title}\n"
+        f"created: {note.created}\n"
+        f"updated: {note.updated}\n"
+        f"\n{note.body}".rstrip("\n")
+    )
+
+
+def run(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None, *, out=None, err=None) -> int:
+    """Run the CLI. Returns a process exit code."""
+    out = out or sys.stdout
+    err = err or sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file if args.file is not None else default_path()
+    store = NotesStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"added note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.list()
+            if not notes:
+                print("no notes", file=out)
+            for note in notes:
+                print(_format_summary(note), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_full(store.get(args.id)), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "edit":
+            if args.title is None and args.body is None:
+                print("error: nothing to change; use --title and/or --body", file=err)
+                return 2
+            note = store.update(args.id, title=args.title, body=args.body)
+            print(f"updated note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"deleted note {args.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            matches = store.search(args.query)
+            if not matches:
+                print("no matches", file=out)
+            for note in matches:
+                print(_format_summary(note), file=out)
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {args.id}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    sys.exit(run())

+"""Storage layer for notes, backed by a JSON file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created: str
+    updated: str
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes persisted to a JSON file.
+
+    The file is created on first write. Writes are atomic (temp file + rename)
+    so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt existing notes.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]):
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # --- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+                fh.write("\n")
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    # --- operations --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _now() -> str:
+        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        now = self._now()
+        note = Note(id=next_id, title=title, body=body, created=now, updated=now)
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def update(
+        self, note_id: int, *, title: str | None = None, body: str | None = None
+    ) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for note in notes:
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                if title is not None:
+                    title = title.strip()
+                    if not title:
+                        raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+                    note.title = title
+                if body is not None:
+                    note.body = body
+                note.updated = self._now()
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
+        notes = self._load()
+        remaining = [n for n in notes if n.id != note_id]
+        if len(remaining) == len(notes):
+            raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+        self._save(remaining)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        q = query.lower()
+        return [n for n in self.list() if q in n.title.lower() or q in n.body.lower()]

+"""Command interpreter operating on a dict-backed key/value store."""
+
+import re
+
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+_INTEGER = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+")
+
+
+def _parse_int(text):
+    if not _INTEGER.fullmatch(text):
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}")
+    return int(text)
+
+
+def _require_key(store, key):
+    if key not in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"no such key: {key}")
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _cmd_set(args, store):
+    key, value = args[0], " ".join(args[1:])
+    store[key] = value
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_get(args, store):
+    return _require_key(store, args[0])
+
+
+def _cmd_del(args, store):
+    if args[0] in store:
+        del store[args[0]]
+        return "1"
+    return "0"
+
+
+def _cmd_exists(args, store):
+    return "1" if args[0] in store else "0"
+
+
+def _adjust(args, store, sign):
+    key = args[0]
+    delta = _parse_int(args[1]) if len(args) == 2 else 1
+    current = _parse_int(store.get(key, "0"))
+    new = current + sign * delta
+    store[key] = str(new)
+    return str(new)
+
+
+def _cmd_incr(args, store):
+    return _adjust(args, store, +1)
+
+
+def _cmd_decr(args, store):
+    return _adjust(args, store, -1)
+
+
+def _cmd_append(args, store):
+    key = args[0]
+    value = store.get(key, "") + " ".join(args[1:])
+    store[key] = value
+    return str(len(value))
+
+
+def _cmd_rename(args, store):
+    old, new = args
+    value = _require_key(store, old)
+    if new in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"key exists: {new}")
+    del store[old]
+    store[new] = value
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_swap(args, store):
+    a, b = args
+    _require_key(store, a)
+    _require_key(store, b)
+    store[a], store[b] = store[b], store[a]
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_keys(args, store):
+    prefix = args[0] if args else ""
+    matches = sorted(k for k in store if k.startswith(prefix))
+    return " ".join(matches) if matches else "(empty)"
+
+
+def _cmd_count(args, store):
+    return str(len(store))
+
+
+def _cmd_clear(args, store):
+    store.clear()
+    return "OK"
+
+
+# name -> (min args, max args or None for unbounded, handler)
+_COMMANDS = {
+    "set": (2, None, _cmd_set),
+    "get": (1, 1, _cmd_get),
+    "del": (1, 1, _cmd_del),
+    "exists": (1, 1, _cmd_exists),
+    "incr": (1, 2, _cmd_incr),
+    "decr": (1, 2, _cmd_decr),
+    "append": (2, None, _cmd_append),
+    "rename": (2, 2, _cmd_rename),
+    "swap": (2, 2, _cmd_swap),
+    "keys": (0, 1, _cmd_keys),
+    "count": (0, 0, _cmd_count),
+    "clear": (0, 0, _cmd_clear),
+}
+
+
+def execute(line, store):
+    """Run one command line against ``store`` and return its result string."""
+    words = line.split()
+    if not words:
+        raise CommandError("empty command")
+
+    typed, args = words[0], words[1:]
+    name = typed.lower()
+    spec = _COMMANDS.get(name)
+    if spec is None:
+        raise CommandError(f"unknown command: {typed}")
+
+    min_args, max_args, handler = spec
+    if len(args) < min_args or (max_args is not None and len(args) > max_args):
+        raise CommandError(f"wrong number of arguments for {name}")
+
+    return handler(args, store)

+"""Gradebook module for tracking student scores and computing course grades.
+
+Scores are recorded per (student, assignment). A score that has not been
+recorded is treated as "not yet graded" and is excluded from calculations;
+an explicit score of 0 counts against the student.
+
+Course grades are computed as a weighted average of category percentages.
+Each category's percentage is total points earned divided by total points
+possible across its graded assignments. Categories without a configured
+weight default to 1.0. Categories with no graded work are ignored and the
+remaining weights are renormalized.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+DEFAULT_CATEGORY = "General"
+
+# (minimum percent, letter) pairs, checked in order.
+LETTER_SCALE: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an operation on the gradebook is invalid."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Student:
+    student_id: str
+    name: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    assignment_id: str
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+    category: str = DEFAULT_CATEGORY
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Gradebook:
+    """In-memory gradebook for a single course."""
+
+    name: str = "Untitled Course"
+    _students: dict[str, Student] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    # student_id -> assignment_id -> points earned
+    _scores: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _category_weights: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    # ----- roster and assignments -------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student_id: str, name: str) -> Student:
+        if student_id in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"duplicate student id: {student_id!r}")
+        if not name.strip():
+            raise GradebookError("student name must not be empty")
+        student = Student(student_id, name.strip())
+        self._students[student_id] = student
+        self._scores[student_id] = {}
+        return student
+
+    def add_assignment(
+        self,
+        assignment_id: str,
+        name: str,
+        max_points: float,
+        category: str = DEFAULT_CATEGORY,
+    ) -> Assignment:
+        if assignment_id in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"duplicate assignment id: {assignment_id!r}")
+        if max_points <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("max_points must be greater than zero")
+        if not category.strip():
+            raise GradebookError("category must not be empty")
+        assignment = Assignment(
+            assignment_id, name.strip(), float(max_points), category.strip()
+        )
+        self._assignments[assignment_id] = assignment
+        return assignment
+
+    def set_category_weight(self, category: str, weight: float) -> None:
+        if weight < 0:
+            raise GradebookError("category weight must not be negative")
+        self._category_weights[category] = float(weight)
+
+    def students(self) -> list[Student]:
+        return sorted(self._students.values(), key=lambda s: s.name.lower())
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    # ----- scores -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str, points: float) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        if points < 0:
+            raise GradebookError("points must not be negative")
+        if points > assignment.max_points:
+            raise GradebookError(
+                f"points {points} exceed max {assignment.max_points} for {assignment_id!r}"
+            )
+        self._scores[student_id][assignment_id] = float(points)
+
+    def clear_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        self._scores[student_id].pop(assignment_id, None)
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> float | None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        return self._scores[student_id].get(assignment_id)
+
+    # ----- calculations -----------------------------------------------
+
+    def category_percent(self, student_id: str, category: str) -> float | None:
+        """Percent earned in one category, or None if nothing is graded there."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        earned = 0.0
+        possible = 0.0
+        for assignment_id, points in self._scores[student_id].items():
+            assignment = self._assignments[assignment_id]
+            if assignment.category == category:
+                earned += points
+                possible += assignment.max_points
+        if possible == 0:
+            return None
+        return earned / possible * 100.0
+
+    def course_percent(self, student_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Weighted course percent, or None if the student has no graded work."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        categories = {self._assignments[a].category for a in self._scores[student_id]}
+        total_weight = 0.0
+        weighted_sum = 0.0
+        for category in categories:
+            percent = self.category_percent(student_id, category)
+            if percent is None:
+                continue
+            weight = self._category_weights.get(category, 1.0)
+            total_weight += weight
+            weighted_sum += percent * weight
+        if total_weight == 0:
+            return None
+        return weighted_sum / total_weight
+
+    def letter_grade(self, student_id: str) -> str | None:
+        percent = self.course_percent(student_id)
+        if percent is None:
+            return None
+        return letter_for_percent(percent)
+
+    def class_average(self) -> float | None:
+        """Mean course percent across students who have graded work."""
+        percents = [
+            p for sid in self._students if (p := self.course_percent(sid)) is not None
+        ]
+        if not percents:
+            return None
+        return sum(percents) / len(percents)
+
+    def report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+        """One row per student, sorted by name, suitable for display or export."""
+        rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+        for student in self.students():
+            percent = self.course_percent(student.student_id)
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "student_id": student.student_id,
+                    "name": student.name,
+                    "percent": None if percent is None else round(percent, 2),
+                    "letter": None if percent is None else letter_for_percent(percent),
+                }
+            )
+        return rows
+
+    # ----- helpers ----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student_id: str) -> None:
+        if student_id not in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown student id: {student_id!r}")
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, assignment_id: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self._assignments[assignment_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown assignment id: {assignment_id!r}") from None
+
+
+def letter_for_percent(percent: float) -> str:
+    """Map a percentage to a letter grade using LETTER_SCALE."""
+    for minimum, letter in LETTER_SCALE:
+        if percent >= minimum:
+            return letter
+    return "F"

+"""A small in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base error for inventory operations."""
+
+
+class UnknownItemError(InventoryError, KeyError):
+    """Raised when an SKU is not present in the inventory."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    """A single stocked product, identified by its SKU."""
+
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    price: float
+    quantity: int = 0
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU with quantities and prices."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items
+
+    def add_item(self, sku: str, name: str, price: float, quantity: int = 0) -> Item:
+        """Register a new SKU. Raises ValueError if it already exists."""
+        if not sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise ValueError(f"sku already exists: {sku!r}")
+        if price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price must be non-negative")
+        if quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
+        item = Item(sku=sku, name=name, price=price, quantity=quantity)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise UnknownItemError(sku) from None
+
+    def receive(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Add stock for an existing SKU. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Remove stock for a sale. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if amount > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"cannot sell {amount} of {sku!r}: only {item.quantity} on hand"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def set_price(self, sku: str, price: float) -> None:
+        if price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price must be non-negative")
+        self.get(sku).price = price
+
+    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items whose quantity is at or below threshold, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= threshold),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value(self) -> float:
+        """Sum of price * quantity across all items."""
+        return sum(i.price * i.quantity for i in self._items.values())

+"""Simple gradebook for tracking student scores on weighted assignments."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+LETTER_SCALE: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when a gradebook operation is invalid."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+    weight: float = 1.0
+
+
+class Gradebook:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._students: list[str] = []
+        self._assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = {}
+        # scores[student][assignment_name] -> points earned
+        self._scores: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
+
+    # --- roster and assignments -------------------------------------------
+
+    @property
+    def students(self) -> list[str]:
+        return list(self._students)
+
+    @property
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    def add_student(self, name: str) -> None:
+        name = _clean_name(name, "student")
+        if name in self._scores:
+            raise GradebookError(f"student already exists: {name!r}")
+        self._students.append(name)
+        self._scores[name] = {}
+
+    def add_assignment(self, name: str, max_points: float, weight: float = 1.0) -> None:
+        name = _clean_name(name, "assignment")
+        if name in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"assignment already exists: {name!r}")
+        if max_points <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("max_points must be positive")
+        if weight <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("weight must be positive")
+        self._assignments[name] = Assignment(name, float(max_points), float(weight))
+
+    # --- scores -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def set_score(self, student: str, assignment: str, points: float) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        max_points = self._assignments[assignment].max_points
+        if not 0 <= points <= max_points:
+            raise GradebookError(
+                f"score {points} out of range 0..{max_points} for {assignment!r}"
+            )
+        self._scores[student][assignment] = float(points)
+
+    def get_score(self, student: str, assignment: str) -> float | None:
+        self._require_student(student)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        return self._scores[student].get(assignment)
+
+    # --- calculations -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def course_percentage(self, student: str) -> float | None:
+        """Weighted percentage over graded assignments only.
+
+        Returns None if the student has no scores yet.
+        """
+        self._require_student(student)
+        earned = 0.0
+        possible = 0.0
+        for name, points in self._scores[student].items():
+            assignment = self._assignments[name]
+            earned += points / assignment.max_points * assignment.weight
+            possible += assignment.weight
+        if possible == 0:
+            return None
+        return round(earned / possible * 100, 2)
+
+    def letter_grade(self, student: str) -> str | None:
+        pct = self.course_percentage(student)
+        if pct is None:
+            return None
+        return letter_for_percentage(pct)
+
+    def assignment_average(self, assignment: str) -> float | None:
+        """Mean percentage on an assignment across students who have a score."""
+        self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        max_points = self._assignments[assignment].max_points
+        values = [
+            scores[assignment] / max_points * 100
+            for scores in self._scores.values()
+            if assignment in scores
+        ]
+        if not values:
+            return None
+        return round(sum(values) / len(values), 2)
+
+    def report(self) -> list[tuple[str, float | None, str | None]]:
+        """Return (student, percentage, letter) rows in roster order."""
+        return [
+            (s, self.course_percentage(s), self.letter_grade(s)) for s in self._students
+        ]
+
+    # --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student: str) -> None:
+        if student not in self._scores:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown student: {student!r}")
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, assignment: str) -> None:
+        if assignment not in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown assignment: {assignment!r}")
+
+
+def letter_for_percentage(pct: float) -> str:
+    for cutoff, letter in LETTER_SCALE:
+        if pct >= cutoff:
+            return letter
+    return "F"
+
+
+def _clean_name(name: str, kind: str) -> str:
+    cleaned = name.strip()
+    if not cleaned:
+        raise GradebookError(f"{kind} name must not be empty")
+    return cleaned

+"""Shipping cost calculation."""
+
+ZONE_EU = {"DE", "FR", "ES", "IT", "NL"}
+
+# Upper weight limits (kg) for each bracket, inclusive.
+WEIGHT_BRACKETS = (0.5, 2, 5, 20)
+
+# Base prices per zone, aligned with WEIGHT_BRACKETS.
+BASE_PRICES = {
+    "domestic": (4, 7, 12, 25),
+    "eu": (9, 15, 24, 48),
+    "intl": (14, 24, 40, 80),
+}
+
+TIER_DISCOUNTS = {"silver": 0.05, "gold": 0.10}
+
+HAZMAT_SURCHARGE = 15
+FRAGILE_SURCHARGE = 5
+REMOTE_SURCHARGE = 8
+MINIMUM_CHARGE = 3
+
+
+def _zone(country):
+    if country == "US":
+        return "domestic"
+    if country in ZONE_EU:
+        return "eu"
+    return "intl"
+
+
+def _base_price(zone, weight):
+    if weight <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid weight")
+    if weight > WEIGHT_BRACKETS[-1]:
+        raise ValueError("too heavy")
+    for limit, price in zip(WEIGHT_BRACKETS, BASE_PRICES[zone]):
+        if weight <= limit:
+            return price
+    raise AssertionError("unreachable")
+
+
+def shipping_cost(order):
+    """Return the shipping price in dollars for ``order``, rounded to 2 decimals."""
+    zone = _zone(order["country"])
+    weight = order["weight_kg"]
+    subtotal = order["subtotal"]
+    express = bool(order.get("express", False))
+    fragile = bool(order.get("fragile", False))
+    hazmat = bool(order.get("hazmat", False))
+    remote = bool(order.get("remote", False))
+    tier = order.get("tier")
+
+    if tier is not None and tier not in TIER_DISCOUNTS:
+        raise ValueError("invalid tier")
+    if hazmat and zone == "intl":
+        raise ValueError("hazmat not allowed")
+
+    base = _base_price(zone, weight)
+
+    # Free shipping: domestic, non-express, subtotal of 100 or more.
+    if zone == "domestic" and not express and subtotal >= 100:
+        base = 0
+
+    total = float(base)
+    if express:
+        total += base * (1.0 if zone == "intl" else 0.5)
+    if hazmat:
+        total += HAZMAT_SURCHARGE
+    if fragile:
+        total += FRAGILE_SURCHARGE
+    if remote and zone != "intl":
+        total += REMOTE_SURCHARGE
+
+    if tier is not None:
+        total *= 1 - TIER_DISCOUNTS[tier]
+
+    if 0 < total < MINIMUM_CHARGE:
+        total = MINIMUM_CHARGE
+
+    return round(total, 2)

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+

+

+__all__ = ["build_parser", "main"]

+def _format_note(note: Note, *, full: bool) -> str:
+    header = f"[{note.id}] {note.title}  (updated {note.updated_at})"
+    if full and note.body:
+        return f"{header}\n{note.body}"
+    return header
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A simple command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title", help="note title")
+    p_add.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note in full")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_edit = sub.add_parser("edit", help="change a note's title and/or body")
+    p_edit.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-t", "--title", default=None)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-b", "--body", default=None)
+
+    p_rm = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_rm.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_find = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p_find.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def _print_notes(notes: list[Note], empty_message: str, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    if not notes:
+        print(empty_message, file=out)
+    for note in notes:
+        print(_format_note(note, full=False), file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_add(
+    store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO, err: TextIO
+) -> int:
+    note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+    print(f"Added note {note.id}.", file=out)
+    return 0
+
+
+def _cmd_list(
+    store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO, err: TextIO
+) -> int:
+    _print_notes(store.all(), "No notes.", out)
+    return 0
+
+
+def _cmd_show(
+    store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO, err: TextIO
+) -> int:
+    print(_format_note(store.get(args.id), full=True), file=out)
+    return 0
+
+
+def _cmd_edit(
+    store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO, err: TextIO
+) -> int:
+    if args.title is None and args.body is None:
+        print("error: nothing to edit; pass --title and/or --body", file=err)
+        return 2
+    note = store.update(args.id, title=args.title, body=args.body)
+    print(f"Updated note {note.id}.", file=out)
+    return 0
+
+
+def _cmd_delete(
+    store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO, err: TextIO
+) -> int:
+    store.delete(args.id)
+    print(f"Deleted note {args.id}.", file=out)
+    return 0
+
+
+def _cmd_search(
+    store: NoteStore, args: argparse.Namespace, out: TextIO, err: TextIO
+) -> int:
+    _print_notes(store.search(args.query), "No matches.", out)
+    return 0
+
+
+_HANDLERS = {
+    "add": _cmd_add,
+    "list": _cmd_list,
+    "show": _cmd_show,
+    "edit": _cmd_edit,
+    "delete": _cmd_delete,
+    "search": _cmd_search,
+}
+
+
+def main(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    stdout: TextIO | None = None,
+    stderr: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    out = stdout if stdout is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = stderr if stderr is not None else sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file if args.file is not None else default_store_path()
+    store = NoteStore(path)
+    handler = _HANDLERS[args.command]
+
+    try:
+        return handler(store, args, out, err)
+    except NoteNotFoundError as exc:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {exc.args[0]}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 1

+"""Storage layer for notes, persisted as a JSON file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    """A single note with timestamps stored as ISO 8601 UTC strings."""
+
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created_at: str
+    updated_at: str
+
+
+def default_store_path() -> Path:
+    """Return the notes file path, honouring the NOTES_FILE environment variable."""
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    if env:
+        return Path(env).expanduser()
+    return Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """A collection of notes stored in a single JSON file."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path | str) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write does not corrupt the file.
+        fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+                fh.write("\n")
+            os.replace(tmp_name, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp_name):
+                os.unlink(tmp_name)
+            raise
+
+    # -- operations ------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        """Create and persist a note, returning it. Raises ValueError if the title is blank."""
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        now = _now()
+        note = Note(id=next_id, title=title, body=body, created_at=now, updated_at=now)
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def all(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return every stored note sorted by id. Returns an empty list if the file is missing."""
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Return the note with the given id. Raises NoteNotFoundError if it does not exist."""
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def update(
+        self, note_id: int, *, title: str | None = None, body: str | None = None
+    ) -> Note:
+        """Change a note's title and/or body (None leaves a field unchanged) and return it.
+
+        Raises NoteNotFoundError if the id does not exist, or ValueError if the new title is blank.
+        """
+        notes = self._load()
+        for note in notes:
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                if title is not None:
+                    title = title.strip()
+                    if not title:
+                        raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+                    note.title = title
+                if body is not None:
+                    note.body = body
+                note.updated_at = _now()
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
+        """Remove the note with the given id. Raises NoteNotFoundError if it does not exist."""
+        notes = self._load()
+        remaining = [n for n in notes if n.id != note_id]
+        if len(remaining) == len(notes):
+            raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+        self._save(remaining)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return notes whose title or body contains query (case-insensitive), sorted by id."""
+        needle = query.lower()
+        return [
+            n
+            for n in self.all()
+            if needle in n.title.lower() or needle in n.body.lower()
+        ]

+"""Validation rules for invoice dicts."""
+
+import datetime
+import math
+import re
+
+CURRENCIES = ("USD", "EUR", "GBP")
+MAX_NOTES_LENGTH = 500
+_ISO_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
+
+
+def _is_blank(value):
+    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() == "")
+
+
+def _is_number(value):
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return False
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return True
+    return isinstance(value, float) and math.isfinite(value)
+
+
+def _parse_date(value):
+    """Return a date for a strict YYYY-MM-DD string, or None."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _ISO_DATE_RE.fullmatch(value):
+        return None
+    try:
+        return datetime.date.fromisoformat(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _check_line(line):
+    """Return the per-line error messages (without the line number prefix)."""
+    errors = []
+    if not isinstance(line, dict):
+        line = {}
+
+    sku = line.get("sku")
+    if not isinstance(sku, str) or sku.strip() == "":
+        errors.append("missing sku")
+
+    qty = line.get("qty")
+    if not (isinstance(qty, int) and not isinstance(qty, bool) and qty > 0):
+        errors.append("bad quantity")
+
+    price = line.get("price")
+    if not _is_number(price) or price < 0:
+        errors.append("bad price")
+
+    return errors
+
+
+def _lines_valid(lines):
+    return isinstance(lines, list) and len(lines) > 0
+
+
+def validate_invoice(invoice):
+    """Return a list of error strings for ``invoice``; an empty list means valid.
+
+    Never raises for bad data: a non-dict invoice is treated as having no fields.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
+        invoice = {}
+
+    errors = []
+
+    if _is_blank(invoice.get("id")):
+        errors.append("missing id")
+
+    if _is_blank(invoice.get("customer")):
+        errors.append("missing customer")
+
+    currency = invoice.get("currency")
+    if not (isinstance(currency, str) and currency in CURRENCIES):
+        errors.append("unsupported currency")
+
+    issued = _parse_date(invoice.get("issued"))
+    if issued is None:
+        errors.append("bad issue date")
+
+    due = _parse_date(invoice.get("due"))
+    if due is None:
+        errors.append("bad due date")
+
+    if issued is not None and due is not None and due < issued:
+        errors.append("due before issued")
+
+    lines = invoice.get("lines")
+    if not _lines_valid(lines):
+        errors.append("no lines")
+        lines = []
+
+    all_lines_valid = True
+    for number, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
+        line_errors = _check_line(line)
+        if line_errors:
+            all_lines_valid = False
+        for message in line_errors:
+            errors.append(f"line {number}: {message}")
+
+    seen_skus = set()
+    reported_skus = set()
+    for line in lines:
+        sku = line.get("sku") if isinstance(line, dict) else None
+        if not isinstance(sku, str) or sku.strip() == "":
+            continue
+        if sku in seen_skus:
+            if sku not in reported_skus:
+                errors.append(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+                reported_skus.add(sku)
+        else:
+            seen_skus.add(sku)
+
+    tax_rate = invoice.get("tax_rate")
+    tax_rate_ok = True
+    if tax_rate is not None:
+        if not (_is_number(tax_rate) and 0 <= tax_rate <= 0.5):
+            tax_rate_ok = False
+            errors.append("bad tax rate")
+
+    total = invoice.get("total")
+    if total is not None and all_lines_valid and tax_rate_ok and lines:
+        rate = 0 if tax_rate is None else tax_rate
+        subtotal = sum(line["qty"] * line["price"] for line in lines)
+        expected = round(subtotal * (1 + rate), 2)
+        if not (_is_number(total) and total == expected):
+            errors.append("total mismatch")
+
+    notes = invoice.get("notes")
+    if notes is not None and isinstance(notes, str) and len(notes) > MAX_NOTES_LENGTH:
+        errors.append("notes too long")
+
+    return errors

+"""Simple gradebook for tracking student scores on assignments.
+
+Scores are stored per (student, assignment). A student's percentage is
+computed over only the assignments that have a recorded score, so ungraded
+work does not count against them.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+# Lower bound (inclusive) for each letter grade, checked from highest to lowest.
+LETTER_SCALE: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(ValueError):
+    """Raised for invalid gradebook operations (unknown names, bad scores, etc.)."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Student:
+    student_id: str
+    name: str
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Gradebook:
+    """Tracks students, assignments, and scores for a single class."""
+
+    _students: dict[str, Student] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    # scores[student_id][assignment_name] = points earned
+    _scores: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    # --- students -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student_id: str, name: str) -> Student:
+        if not student_id:
+            raise GradebookError("student_id must be non-empty")
+        if student_id in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"student {student_id!r} already exists")
+        student = Student(student_id, name)
+        self._students[student_id] = student
+        self._scores[student_id] = {}
+        return student
+
+    def students(self) -> list[Student]:
+        return list(self._students.values())
+
+    # --- assignments ----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_assignment(self, name: str, max_points: float) -> Assignment:
+        if not name:
+            raise GradebookError("assignment name must be non-empty")
+        if name in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"assignment {name!r} already exists")
+        if max_points <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("max_points must be greater than zero")
+        assignment = Assignment(name, float(max_points))
+        self._assignments[name] = assignment
+        return assignment
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    # --- scores ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(
+        self, student_id: str, assignment_name: str, points: float
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record (or overwrite) a student's score on an assignment."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._require_assignment(assignment_name)
+        if points < 0:
+            raise GradebookError("points cannot be negative")
+        if points > assignment.max_points:
+            raise GradebookError(
+                f"points {points} exceed max_points {assignment.max_points} "
+                f"for {assignment_name!r}"
+            )
+        self._scores[student_id][assignment_name] = float(points)
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_name: str) -> float | None:
+        """Return the recorded score, or None if the work has not been graded."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_name)
+        return self._scores[student_id].get(assignment_name)
+
+    def student_percent(self, student_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Percentage over graded assignments only, or None if nothing is graded."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        earned = 0.0
+        possible = 0.0
+        for name, points in self._scores[student_id].items():
+            earned += points
+            possible += self._assignments[name].max_points
+        if possible == 0:
+            return None
+        return round(earned / possible * 100, 2)
+
+    def letter_grade(self, student_id: str) -> str | None:
+        """Letter grade for a student, or None if nothing is graded yet."""
+        percent = self.student_percent(student_id)
+        if percent is None:
+            return None
+        return letter_for_percent(percent)
+
+    def class_average(self) -> float | None:
+        """Mean of student percentages across students with at least one grade."""
+        percents = [
+            p for sid in self._students if (p := self.student_percent(sid)) is not None
+        ]
+        if not percents:
+            return None
+        return round(sum(percents) / len(percents), 2)
+
+    # --- helpers --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student_id: str) -> None:
+        if student_id not in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown student {student_id!r}")
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, name: str) -> Assignment:
+        if name not in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown assignment {name!r}")
+        return self._assignments[name]
+
+
+def letter_for_percent(percent: float) -> str:
+    """Map a percentage (0-100) to a letter grade using LETTER_SCALE."""
+    if percent < 0:
+        raise GradebookError("percent cannot be negative")
+    for threshold, letter in LETTER_SCALE:
+        if percent >= threshold:
+            return letter
+    return "F"  # pragma: no cover - unreachable given the 0.0 threshold

+"""A small key-value command interpreter.
+
+`execute(line, store)` parses one command line and applies it to `store`,
+a dict of string keys to string values. It returns the result as a string
+and raises `CommandError` for every error.
+"""
+
+import re
+
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+_INT_RE = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+")
+
+
+def _parse_int(text):
+    if not _INT_RE.fullmatch(text):
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}")
+    try:
+        return int(text)
+    except ValueError:  # digit string too long for int()
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}") from None
+
+
+def _require_key(store, key):
+    if key not in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"no such key: {key}")
+
+
+def _set(args, store):
+    key = args[0]
+    store[key] = " ".join(args[1:])
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _get(args, store):
+    key = args[0]
+    _require_key(store, key)
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _del(args, store):
+    key = args[0]
+    if key in store:
+        del store[key]
+        return "1"
+    return "0"
+
+
+def _exists(args, store):
+    return "1" if args[0] in store else "0"
+
+
+def _add_to_int(args, store, sign):
+    key = args[0]
+    delta = _parse_int(args[1]) if len(args) == 2 else 1
+    current = _parse_int(store[key]) if key in store else 0
+    new = current + sign * delta
+    store[key] = str(new)
+    return str(new)
+
+
+def _incr(args, store):
+    return _add_to_int(args, store, +1)
+
+
+def _decr(args, store):
+    return _add_to_int(args, store, -1)
+
+
+def _append(args, store):
+    key = args[0]
+    new = store.get(key, "") + " ".join(args[1:])
+    store[key] = new
+    return str(len(new))
+
+
+def _rename(args, store):
+    old, new = args
+    _require_key(store, old)
+    if new in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"key exists: {new}")
+    store[new] = store.pop(old)
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _swap(args, store):
+    a, b = args
+    _require_key(store, a)
+    _require_key(store, b)
+    store[a], store[b] = store[b], store[a]
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _keys(args, store):
+    prefix = args[0] if args else ""
+    matches = sorted(k for k in store if k.startswith(prefix))
+    return " ".join(matches) if matches else "(empty)"
+
+
+def _count(args, store):
+    return str(len(store))
+
+
+def _clear(args, store):
+    store.clear()
+    return "OK"
+
+
+# name -> (min number of args, max number of args or None, handler)
+_COMMANDS = {
+    "set": (2, None, _set),
+    "get": (1, 1, _get),
+    "del": (1, 1, _del),
+    "exists": (1, 1, _exists),
+    "incr": (1, 2, _incr),
+    "decr": (1, 2, _decr),
+    "append": (2, None, _append),
+    "rename": (2, 2, _rename),
+    "swap": (2, 2, _swap),
+    "keys": (0, 1, _keys),
+    "count": (0, 0, _count),
+    "clear": (0, 0, _clear),
+}
+
+
+def execute(line, store):
+    """Run one command line against `store` and return its result string."""
+    words = line.split()
+    if not words:
+        raise CommandError("empty command")
+
+    typed_name, args = words[0], words[1:]
+    name = typed_name.lower()
+    spec = _COMMANDS.get(name)
+    if spec is None:
+        raise CommandError(f"unknown command: {typed_name}")
+
+    min_args, max_args, handler = spec
+    if len(args) < min_args or (max_args is not None and len(args) > max_args):
+        raise CommandError(f"wrong number of arguments for {name}")
+
+    return handler(args, store)

+
+def _is_present_str(value):
+    """True for a string that is not blank after stripping whitespace."""
+    return isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() != ""
+
+
+def _is_number(value: object) -> TypeGuard[int | float]:
+    """True for an int or float that is not a bool and is finite."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return False
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return True
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return math.isfinite(value)
+    return False
+
+
+def _is_positive_int(value):
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value > 0
+
+
+def _parse_iso_date(value):
+    """Return a datetime.date for a YYYY-MM-DD string, or None if invalid."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or _ISO_DATE_RE.fullmatch(value) is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return datetime.date(int(value[0:4]), int(value[5:7]), int(value[8:10]))
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _check_header(invoice, errors):
+    """Rules 1-6: id, customer, currency, dates."""
+    if not _is_present_str(invoice.get("id")):
+        errors.append("missing id")
+
+    if not _is_present_str(invoice.get("customer")):
+        errors.append("missing customer")
+
+    if invoice.get("currency") not in CURRENCIES:
+        errors.append("unsupported currency")
+
+    issued = _parse_iso_date(invoice.get("issued"))
+    if issued is None:
+        errors.append("bad issue date")
+
+    due = _parse_iso_date(invoice.get("due"))
+    if due is None:
+        errors.append("bad due date")
+
+    if issued is not None and due is not None and due < issued:
+        errors.append("due before issued")
+
+
+def _check_line_fields(number, line, errors):
+    """Rule 8 for a single line. Returns True if the line is valid."""
+    is_valid = True
+
+    if not _is_present_str(line.get("sku")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: missing sku")
+        is_valid = False
+
+    if not _is_positive_int(line.get("qty")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad quantity")
+        is_valid = False
+
+    price = line.get("price")
+    if not (_is_number(price) and price >= 0):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad price")
+        is_valid = False
+
+    return is_valid
+
+
+def _check_lines(lines, errors):
+    """Rules 7-9. Returns True if every line passes the per-line checks."""
+    if not isinstance(lines, list) or len(lines) == 0:
+        errors.append("no lines")
+        return False
+
+    all_lines_valid = True
+    seen_skus = set()
+    reported_duplicates = set()
+    duplicate_errors = []
+
+    for number, raw_line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
+        line = raw_line if isinstance(raw_line, dict) else {}
+
+        if not _check_line_fields(number, line, errors):
+            all_lines_valid = False
+
+        sku = line.get("sku")
+        if not _is_present_str(sku):
+            continue
+        if sku not in seen_skus:
+            seen_skus.add(sku)
+        elif sku not in reported_duplicates:
+            reported_duplicates.add(sku)
+            duplicate_errors.append(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+
+    errors.extend(duplicate_errors)
+    return all_lines_valid
+
+
+def _check_tax_rate(invoice, errors):
+    """Rule 10. Returns the tax rate to use (0 if absent), or None if invalid."""
+    tax_rate = invoice.get("tax_rate")
+    if tax_rate is None:
+        return 0
+    if not _is_number(tax_rate) or not (0 <= tax_rate <= MAX_TAX_RATE):
+        errors.append("bad tax rate")
+        return None
+    return tax_rate
+
+
+def _check_total(invoice, lines, tax_rate, errors):
+    """Rule 11."""
+    total = invoice.get("total")
+    if total is None:
+        return
+
+    try:
+        subtotal = sum(line["qty"] * line["price"] for line in lines)
+        expected = round(subtotal * (1 + tax_rate), 2)
+    except (OverflowError, TypeError, ValueError):
+        errors.append("total mismatch")
+        return
+
+    if not _is_number(total) or total != expected:
+        errors.append("total mismatch")
+
+
+def _check_notes(invoice, errors):
+    """Rule 12."""
+    notes = invoice.get("notes")
+    if isinstance(notes, str) and len(notes) > MAX_NOTES_LENGTH:
+        errors.append("notes too long")
+
+
+def validate_invoice(invoice):
+    """Validate an invoice dict and return a list of error strings.
+
+    An empty list means the invoice is valid. Errors are reported in the
+    order of the rules; this function does not raise for malformed data.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
+        invoice = {}
+
+    errors = []
+
+    _check_header(invoice, errors)
+
+    lines = invoice.get("lines")
+    all_lines_valid = _check_lines(lines, errors)
+
+    tax_rate = _check_tax_rate(invoice, errors)
+
+    if all_lines_valid and tax_rate is not None:
+        _check_total(invoice, lines, tax_rate, errors)
+
+    _check_notes(invoice, errors)
+
+    return errors

+"""Command interpreter operating on a dict-backed key/value store."""
+
+import re
+
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+_INT_RE = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+")
+
+
+def _parse_int(text):
+    if not _INT_RE.fullmatch(text):
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}")
+    return int(text)
+
+
+def _check_args(name, args, low, high=None):
+    """Raise if len(args) is outside [low, high]; high=None means unbounded."""
+    if len(args) < low or (high is not None and len(args) > high):
+        raise CommandError(f"wrong number of arguments for {name}")
+
+
+def _require_key(store, key):
+    if key not in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"no such key: {key}")
+
+
+def _cmd_set(store, args):
+    _check_args("set", args, 2)
+    key = args[0]
+    store[key] = " ".join(args[1:])
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_get(store, args):
+    _check_args("get", args, 1, 1)
+    key = args[0]
+    _require_key(store, key)
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _cmd_del(store, args):
+    _check_args("del", args, 1, 1)
+    if args[0] in store:
+        del store[args[0]]
+        return "1"
+    return "0"
+
+
+def _cmd_exists(store, args):
+    _check_args("exists", args, 1, 1)
+    return "1" if args[0] in store else "0"
+
+
+def _adjust(store, args, name, sign):
+    _check_args(name, args, 1, 2)
+    key = args[0]
+    delta = _parse_int(args[1]) if len(args) == 2 else 1
+    current = _parse_int(store[key]) if key in store else 0
+    result = str(current + sign * delta)
+    store[key] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def _cmd_incr(store, args):
+    return _adjust(store, args, "incr", +1)
+
+
+def _cmd_decr(store, args):
+    return _adjust(store, args, "decr", -1)
+
+
+def _cmd_append(store, args):
+    _check_args("append", args, 2)
+    key = args[0]
+    value = store.get(key, "") + " ".join(args[1:])
+    store[key] = value
+    return str(len(value))
+
+
+def _cmd_rename(store, args):
+    _check_args("rename", args, 2, 2)
+    old, new = args
+    _require_key(store, old)
+    if new in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"key exists: {new}")
+    store[new] = store.pop(old)
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_swap(store, args):
+    _check_args("swap", args, 2, 2)
+    a, b = args
+    _require_key(store, a)
+    _require_key(store, b)
+    store[a], store[b] = store[b], store[a]
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_keys(store, args):
+    _check_args("keys", args, 0, 1)
+    prefix = args[0] if args else ""
+    matches = sorted(k for k in store if k.startswith(prefix))
+    return " ".join(matches) if matches else "(empty)"
+
+
+def _cmd_count(store, args):
+    _check_args("count", args, 0, 0)
+    return str(len(store))
+
+
+def _cmd_clear(store, args):
+    _check_args("clear", args, 0, 0)
+    store.clear()
+    return "OK"
+
+
+_COMMANDS = {
+    "set": _cmd_set,
+    "get": _cmd_get,
+    "del": _cmd_del,
+    "exists": _cmd_exists,
+    "incr": _cmd_incr,
+    "decr": _cmd_decr,
+    "append": _cmd_append,
+    "rename": _cmd_rename,
+    "swap": _cmd_swap,
+    "keys": _cmd_keys,
+    "count": _cmd_count,
+    "clear": _cmd_clear,
+}
+
+
+def execute(line, store):
+    """Run one command line against store and return its result string.
+
+    Raises CommandError for any invalid input.
+    """
+    words = line.split()
+    if not words:
+        raise CommandError("empty command")
+    typed_name = words[0]
+    name = typed_name.lower()
+    handler = _COMMANDS.get(name)
+    if handler is None:
+        raise CommandError(f"unknown command: {typed_name}")
+    return handler(store, words[1:])

+import pytest
+
+from app.commands import execute
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+
+def run(line, store):
+    return execute(line, store)
+
+
+def err(line, store):
+    with pytest.raises(CommandError) as info:
+        execute(line, store)
+    return str(info.value)
+
+
+# --- set / get ---
+
+
+def test_set_and_get():
+    s = {}
+    assert run("set a hello", s) == "OK"
+    assert run("get a", s) == "hello"
+
+
+def test_set_joins_remaining_words_with_single_spaces():
+    s = {}
+    run("set k  one   two\tthree", s)
+    assert s["k"] == "one two three"
+
+
+def test_set_overwrites():
+    s = {"a": "1"}
+    run("set a 2", s)
+    assert s["a"] == "2"
+
+
+def test_get_missing_key_is_error():
+    assert err("get nope", {}) == "no such key: nope"
+
+
+def test_set_requires_value():
+    assert err("set a", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for set"
+
+
+def test_get_arg_count():
+    assert err("get", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for get"
+    assert err("get a b", {"a": "1"}) == "wrong number of arguments for get"
+
+
+# --- del / exists ---
+
+
+def test_del_existing_and_missing():
+    s = {"a": "1"}
+    assert run("del a", s) == "1"
+    assert "a" not in s
+    assert run("del a", s) == "0"
+
+
+def test_exists():
+    s = {"a": ""}
+    assert run("exists a", s) == "1"
+    assert run("exists b", s) == "0"
+
+
+def test_del_exists_arg_count():
+    assert err("del", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for del"
+    assert err("exists", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for exists"
+
+
+# --- incr / decr ---
+
+
+def test_incr_default_and_missing_key():

+
+
+def test_incr_with_amount_and_negative():
+    s = {"c": "10"}
+    assert run("incr c 5", s) == "15"
+    assert run("incr c -20", s) == "-5"
+
+
+def test_decr():
+    s = {}
+    assert run("decr c", s) == "-1"

+
+def test_incr_stored_non_integer():

+
+def test_incr_bad_amount():
+    assert err("incr c x1", {}) == "not an integer: x1"
+    assert err("decr c 1.5", {}) == "not an integer: 1.5"
+
+
+def test_incr_does_not_change_store_on_error():
+    s = {"c": "abc"}
+    err("incr c", s)
+    assert s == {"c": "abc"}
+
+
+def test_incr_decr_arg_count():
+    assert err("incr", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for incr"
+    assert err("incr a 1 2", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for incr"
+    assert err("decr", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for decr"
+    assert err("decr a 1 2", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for decr"
+
+
+# --- append ---
+
+
+def test_append_missing_key_counts_as_empty():
+    s = {}
+    assert run("append a hi there", s) == "8"
+    assert s["a"] == "hi there"
+
+
+def test_append_existing():
+    s = {"a": "foo"}
+    assert run("append a  bar  baz", s) == str(len("foo" + "bar baz"))
+    assert s["a"] == "foobar baz"
+
+
+def test_append_requires_text():
+    assert err("append a", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for append"
+
+
+# --- rename ---
+
+
+def test_rename_moves_value():
+    s = {"a": "1"}
+    assert run("rename a b", s) == "OK"
+    assert s == {"b": "1"}
+
+
+def test_rename_missing_old():
+    assert err("rename a b", {}) == "no such key: a"
+
+
+def test_rename_onto_existing():

+
+def test_rename_arg_count():
