+"""Command-line interface for the notes app.
+
+Usage:
+    python -m app [--file PATH] add TITLE [-b BODY]
+    python -m app [--file PATH] list
+    python -m app [--file PATH] show ID
+    python -m app [--file PATH] edit ID [-t TITLE] [-b BODY]
+    python -m app [--file PATH] delete ID
+    python -m app [--file PATH] search QUERY
+
+The notes file defaults to $NOTES_FILE, or ~/.notes.json if unset.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Sequence, TextIO
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NotesStore
+
+
+def default_notes_path() -> Path:
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    if env:
+        return Path(env)
+    return Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A simple command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title")
+    p_add.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_edit = sub.add_parser("edit", help="change a note's title and/or body")
+    p_edit.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-t", "--title", default=None)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-b", "--body", default=None)
+
+    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p_search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def _format_note_line(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"{note.id:>4}  {note.title}"
+
+
+def _format_note_full(note: Note) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"#{note.id} {note.title}\n"
+        f"created: {note.created_at}\n"
+        f"updated: {note.updated_at}\n"
+        f"\n{note.body}"
+    ).rstrip() + "\n"
+
+
+def run(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    out: TextIO | None = None,
+    err: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    out = out if out is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = err if err is not None else sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file if args.file is not None else default_notes_path()
+    store = NotesStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"added note #{note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.list()
+            if not notes:
+                print("no notes", file=out)
+            for note in notes:
+                print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note_full(store.get(args.id)), end="", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "edit":
+            if args.title is None and args.body is None:
+                print("error: nothing to edit; pass --title and/or --body", file=err)
+                return 2
+            note = store.update(args.id, title=args.title, body=args.body)
+            print(f"updated note #{note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"deleted note #{args.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            results = store.search(args.query)
+            if not results:
+                print("no matches", file=out)
+            for note in results:
+                print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {args.id}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    sys.exit(run())

+"""Storage layer for notes, backed by a JSON file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Iterable
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created_at: str
+    updated_at: str
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes persisted to a JSON file.
+
+    The file is created on first write. A missing file is treated as empty.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: Iterable[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        tmp = self.path.with_name(self.path.name + ".tmp")
+        with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+            fh.write("\n")
+        os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+
+    # -- operations ------------------------------------------------------
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _now() -> str:
+        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        now = self._now()
+        note = Note(id=next_id, title=title, body=body, created_at=now, updated_at=now)
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def update(
+        self, note_id: int, *, title: str | None = None, body: str | None = None
+    ) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                new_title = note.title if title is None else title.strip()
+                if not new_title:
+                    raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+                updated = Note(
+                    id=note.id,
+                    title=new_title,
+                    body=note.body if body is None else body,
+                    created_at=note.created_at,
+                    updated_at=self._now(),
+                )
+                notes[i] = updated
+                self._save(notes)
+                return updated
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
+        notes = self._load()
+        remaining = [n for n in notes if n.id != note_id]
+        if len(remaining) == len(notes):
+            raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+        self._save(remaining)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        q = query.lower()
+        return [n for n in self.list() if q in n.title.lower() or q in n.body.lower()]

+"""Validation rules for invoice dicts."""
+
+import math
+import re
+from datetime import date
+
+SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = ("USD", "EUR", "GBP")
+MAX_NOTES_LENGTH = 500
+MAX_TAX_RATE = 0.5
+
+_ISO_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
+
+
+def _is_blank(value):
+    """True if value is missing (None) or a whitespace-only string."""
+    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() == "")
+
+
+def _is_valid_sku(value):
+    return isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() != ""
+
+
+def _is_number(value):
+    """True for int/float values that are not bools (and finite for floats)."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return False
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return True
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return math.isfinite(value)
+    return False
+
+
+def _is_positive_int(value):
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value > 0
+
+
+def _parse_date(value):
+    """Return a date for a strict YYYY-MM-DD string, otherwise None."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _ISO_DATE_RE.fullmatch(value):
+        return None
+    try:
+        return date(int(value[0:4]), int(value[5:7]), int(value[8:10]))
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _check_header(inv):
+    """Rules 1-6: identifiers, currency and dates."""
+    errors = []
+    if _is_blank(inv.get("id")):
+        errors.append("missing id")
+    if _is_blank(inv.get("customer")):
+        errors.append("missing customer")
+    if inv.get("currency") not in SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES:
+        errors.append("unsupported currency")
+
+    issued = _parse_date(inv.get("issued"))
+    if issued is None:
+        errors.append("bad issue date")
+    due = _parse_date(inv.get("due"))
+    if due is None:
+        errors.append("bad due date")
+    if issued is not None and due is not None and due < issued:
+        errors.append("due before issued")
+    return errors
+
+
+def _check_line(number, fields):
+    """Rule 8 for one line. Returns the list of errors for that line."""
+    errors = []
+    if not _is_valid_sku(fields.get("sku")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: missing sku")
+    if not _is_positive_int(fields.get("qty")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad quantity")
+    price = fields.get("price")
+    if not _is_number(price) or price < 0:
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad price")
+    return errors
+
+
+def _check_duplicate_skus(line_dicts):
+    """Rule 9: report each duplicated sku at its second occurrence."""
+    errors = []
+    sku_counts = {}
+    for fields in line_dicts:
+        sku = fields.get("sku")
+        if not _is_valid_sku(sku):
+            continue
+        sku_counts[sku] = sku_counts.get(sku, 0) + 1
+        if sku_counts[sku] == 2:
+            errors.append(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+    return errors
+
+
+def _check_tax_rate(tax_rate):
+    """Rule 10. Returns (errors, effective_rate); a missing rate counts as 0."""
+    if tax_rate is None:
+        return [], 0
+    if _is_number(tax_rate) and 0 <= tax_rate <= MAX_TAX_RATE:
+        return [], tax_rate
+    return ["bad tax rate"], None
+
+
+def _total_matches(total, line_dicts, tax_rate):
+    """Rule 11 arithmetic: total == round(sum(qty * price) * (1 + tax_rate), 2)."""
+    if not _is_number(total):
+        return False
+    try:
+        subtotal = sum(f["qty"] * f["price"] for f in line_dicts)
+        expected = round(subtotal * (1 + tax_rate), 2)
+    except (OverflowError, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return False
+    return total == expected
+
+
+def _check_lines(lines):
+    """Rules 7-9. Returns (errors, line_dicts, lines_valid).
+
+    lines_valid is False if there are no lines or any per-line error occurred.
+    A non-dict line is treated as having no fields.
+    """
+    if not (isinstance(lines, (list, tuple)) and len(lines) > 0):
+        return ["no lines"], [], False
+
+    line_dicts = [line if isinstance(line, dict) else {} for line in lines]
+    errors = []
+    for number, fields in enumerate(line_dicts, start=1):
+        errors.extend(_check_line(number, fields))
+    lines_valid = not errors
+    errors.extend(_check_duplicate_skus(line_dicts))
+    return errors, line_dicts, lines_valid
+
+
+def validate_invoice(invoice):
+    """Return a list of error strings for invoice (empty list means valid).
+
+    Never raises for bad data; every problem found is reported in rule order.
+    """
+    inv = invoice if isinstance(invoice, dict) else {}
+    errors = _check_header(inv)
+
+    line_errors, line_dicts, lines_valid = _check_lines(inv.get("lines"))
+    errors.extend(line_errors)
+
+    tax_errors, tax_rate = _check_tax_rate(inv.get("tax_rate"))
+    errors.extend(tax_errors)
+
+    # Rule 11: total is only checked when every line and the tax rate are valid.
+    total = inv.get("total")
+    if (
+        total is not None
+        and lines_valid
+        and not tax_errors
+        and not _total_matches(total, line_dicts, tax_rate)
+    ):
+        errors.append("total mismatch")
+
+    # Rule 12: notes length.
+    notes = inv.get("notes")
+    if isinstance(notes, str) and len(notes) > MAX_NOTES_LENGTH:
+        errors.append("notes too long")
+
+    return errors

+"""A small in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base error for inventory operations."""
+
+
+class ItemNotFoundError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when a SKU is not in the inventory."""
+
+
+class DuplicateItemError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when adding a SKU that already exists."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    """A stocked product with its price (in cents) and quantity on hand."""
+
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    price_cents: int
+    quantity: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if self.price_cents < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price_cents must be non-negative")
+        if self.quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU, their stock levels and prices."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items
+
+    def add_item(
+        self, sku: str, name: str, price_cents: int, quantity: int = 0
+    ) -> Item:
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise DuplicateItemError(f"item already exists: {sku}")
+        item = Item(sku=sku, name=name, price_cents=price_cents, quantity=quantity)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise ItemNotFoundError(f"no such item: {sku}") from None
+
+    def remove_item(self, sku: str) -> None:
+        self.get(sku)
+        del self._items[sku]
+
+    def restock(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Increase stock by ``amount`` and return the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Decrease stock by ``amount`` and return the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if amount > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"only {item.quantity} of {sku} on hand, cannot sell {amount}"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def set_price(self, sku: str, price_cents: int) -> None:
+        if price_cents < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price_cents must be non-negative")
+        self.get(sku).price_cents = price_cents
+
+    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items with quantity at or below ``threshold``, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= threshold),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value_cents(self) -> int:
+        """Total value of all stock on hand, in cents."""
+        return sum(i.price_cents * i.quantity for i in self._items.values())

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from argparse import Namespace
+from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TextIO
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NotesStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+Handler = Callable[[Namespace, NotesStore, TextIO], None]
+
+
+def default_path() -> Path:
+    """Return the notes file location: $NOTES_FILE if set, otherwise ~/.notes.json."""
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    return Path(env) if env else DEFAULT_PATH
+
+
+def _format_note_line(note: Note) -> str:
+    """Format a note as a single tab-separated summary line."""
+    return f"{note.id}\t{note.created}\t{note.title}"
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    """Build the argument parser with all subcommands."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notes", description="A simple notes app.")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes JSON file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title")
+    p_add.add_argument("body", nargs="?", default="")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note's full content")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="find notes containing text")
+    p_search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def _cmd_add(args: Namespace, store: NotesStore, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    """Add a note from the parsed arguments and report its id."""
+    note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+    print(f"Added note {note.id}.", file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_list(args: Namespace, store: NotesStore, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    """Print a summary line for every stored note."""
+    notes = store.all()
+    if not notes:
+        print("No notes.", file=out)
+    for note in notes:
+        print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_show(args: Namespace, store: NotesStore, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    """Print the full title and body of the note with the given id."""
+    note = store.get(args.id)
+    print(f"# {note.title}", file=out)
+    print(f"id: {note.id}  created: {note.created}", file=out)
+    if note.body:
+        print("", file=out)
+        print(note.body, file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_delete(args: Namespace, store: NotesStore, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    """Delete the note with the given id and report it."""
+    note = store.delete(args.id)
+    print(f"Deleted note {note.id}.", file=out)
+
+
+def _cmd_search(args: Namespace, store: NotesStore, out: TextIO) -> None:
+    """Print summary lines for notes matching the search query."""
+    matches = store.search(args.query)
+    if not matches:
+        print("No matches.", file=out)
+    for note in matches:
+        print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+
+
+HANDLERS: dict[str, Handler] = {
+    "add": _cmd_add,
+    "list": _cmd_list,
+    "show": _cmd_show,
+    "delete": _cmd_delete,
+    "search": _cmd_search,
+}
+
+
+def main(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    stdout: TextIO | None = None,
+    stderr: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Run the CLI and return an exit code (0 ok, 1 not found, 2 invalid input)."""
+    out = stdout if stdout is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = stderr if stderr is not None else sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file if args.file is not None else default_path()
+    store = NotesStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        HANDLERS[args.command](args, store, out)
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {args.id}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0

+"""Storage layer for the notes app: notes persisted as JSON on disk."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Note:
+    """A single immutable note."""
+
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created: str  # ISO 8601, UTC
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes stored in a single JSON file."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        """Open the store at `path`, loading existing notes if the file exists."""
+        self.path = Path(path)
+        self._notes: list[Note] = self._load()
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        tmp = self.path.with_suffix(self.path.suffix + ".tmp")
+        with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            json.dump([asdict(n) for n in self._notes], fh, indent=2)
+        os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+
+    def _next_id(self) -> int:
+        return max((n.id for n in self._notes), default=0) + 1
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        """Create and persist a note. Raises ValueError if the title is blank."""
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        note = Note(
+            id=self._next_id(),
+            title=title,
+            body=body,
+            created=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        self._notes.append(note)
+        self._save()
+        return note
+
+    def all(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return a copy of all notes in insertion order."""
+        return list(self._notes)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Return the note with `note_id`. Raises NoteNotFoundError if absent."""
+        for note in self._notes:
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Remove and return the note with `note_id`. Raises NoteNotFoundError if absent."""
+        note = self.get(note_id)
+        self._notes.remove(note)
+        self._save()
+        return note
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return notes whose title or body contains `query` (case-insensitive)."""
+        q = query.lower()
+        return [n for n in self._notes if q in n.title.lower() or q in n.body.lower()]

+"""A simple gradebook for teachers.
+
+Students are identified by a unique name or ID. Assignments have a maximum
+point value and a weight. Scores are stored per (student, assignment) pair.
+A student's course average is the weighted mean of their percentage scores
+across the assignments they have been graded on.
+
+Example:
+    >>> gb = Gradebook()
+    >>> gb.add_student("alice")
+    >>> gb.add_assignment("Quiz 1", max_points=10)
+    >>> gb.add_assignment("Final", max_points=100, weight=2)
+    >>> gb.record_score("alice", "Quiz 1", 9)
+    >>> gb.record_score("alice", "Final", 80)
+    >>> round(gb.student_average("alice"), 2)
+    83.33
+    >>> gb.letter_grade("alice")
+    'B'
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Optional
+
+# Lower bound (inclusive) of each letter grade, checked from highest to lowest.
+LETTER_GRADE_CUTOFFS: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when a gradebook operation is invalid."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+    weight: float = 1.0
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Gradebook:
+    _students: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
+    _assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    # student -> assignment name -> points earned
+    _scores: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    # ----- students -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student: str) -> None:
+        if not student or not student.strip():
+            raise GradebookError("student name must be non-empty")
+        if student in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"student already exists: {student!r}")
+        self._students.add(student)
+        self._scores[student] = {}
+
+    def remove_student(self, student: str) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student)
+        self._students.remove(student)
+        del self._scores[student]
+
+    def students(self) -> list[str]:
+        return sorted(self._students)
+
+    # ----- assignments ----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_assignment(self, name: str, max_points: float, weight: float = 1.0) -> None:
+        if not name or not name.strip():
+            raise GradebookError("assignment name must be non-empty")
+        if name in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"assignment already exists: {name!r}")
+        if max_points <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("max_points must be positive")
+        if weight <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("weight must be positive")
+        self._assignments[name] = Assignment(name, float(max_points), float(weight))
+
+    def remove_assignment(self, name: str) -> None:
+        self._require_assignment(name)
+        del self._assignments[name]
+        for scores in self._scores.values():
+            scores.pop(name, None)
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return sorted(self._assignments.values(), key=lambda a: a.name)
+
+    # ----- scores ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(self, student: str, assignment: str, points: float) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student)
+        a = self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        if points < 0 or points > a.max_points:
+            raise GradebookError(
+                f"score {points} out of range 0..{a.max_points:g} for {assignment!r}"
+            )
+        self._scores[student][assignment] = float(points)
+
+    def clear_score(self, student: str, assignment: str) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        self._scores[student].pop(assignment, None)
+
+    def get_score(self, student: str, assignment: str) -> Optional[float]:
+        self._require_student(student)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        return self._scores[student].get(assignment)
+
+    # ----- calculations ---------------------------------------------------
+
+    def student_average(self, student: str) -> Optional[float]:
+        """Weighted percentage (0-100) over graded assignments, or None if none graded."""
+        self._require_student(student)
+        total_weight = 0.0
+        weighted_pct = 0.0
+        for name, points in self._scores[student].items():
+            a = self._assignments[name]
+            total_weight += a.weight
+            weighted_pct += (points / a.max_points) * 100.0 * a.weight
+        if total_weight == 0:
+            return None
+        return weighted_pct / total_weight
+
+    def assignment_average(self, assignment: str) -> Optional[float]:
+        """Mean percentage (0-100) across students who have a score, or None."""
+        a = self._require_assignment(assignment)
+        pcts = [
+            scores[assignment] / a.max_points * 100.0
+            for scores in self._scores.values()
+            if assignment in scores
+        ]
+        if not pcts:
+            return None
+        return sum(pcts) / len(pcts)
+
+    def letter_grade(self, student: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        avg = self.student_average(student)
+        if avg is None:
+            return None
+        return letter_for_percentage(avg)
+
+    def report(self) -> list[tuple[str, Optional[float], Optional[str]]]:
+        """Rows of (student, average percentage, letter grade), sorted by name."""
+        return [
+            (s, self.student_average(s), self.letter_grade(s)) for s in self.students()
+        ]
+
+    # ----- helpers --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student: str) -> None:
+        if student not in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown student: {student!r}")
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, name: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self._assignments[name]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown assignment: {name!r}") from None
+
+
+def letter_for_percentage(percentage: float) -> str:
+    for cutoff, letter in LETTER_GRADE_CUTOFFS:
+        if percentage >= cutoff:
+            return letter
+    return "F"

+"""Shipping cost calculation."""
+
+# Weight brackets: (max_kg, domestic, eu, intl)
+_BRACKETS = (
+    (0.5, 4.0, 9.0, 14.0),
+    (2.0, 7.0, 15.0, 24.0),
+    (5.0, 12.0, 24.0, 40.0),
+    (20.0, 25.0, 48.0, 80.0),
+)
+
+_EU_COUNTRIES = frozenset({"DE", "FR", "ES", "IT", "NL"})
+
+_TIER_DISCOUNT = {"silver": 0.05, "gold": 0.10}
+
+_MIN_CHARGE = 3.0
+_FREE_SHIPPING_SUBTOTAL = 100.0
+
+
+def _zone(country: str) -> str:
+    if country == "US":
+        return "domestic"
+    if country in _EU_COUNTRIES:
+        return "eu"
+    return "intl"
+
+
+def _base_price(weight_kg: float, zone: str) -> float:
+    if weight_kg <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid weight")
+    if weight_kg > _BRACKETS[-1][0]:
+        raise ValueError("too heavy")
+    zone_index = {"domestic": 1, "eu": 2, "intl": 3}[zone]
+    for max_kg, *prices in _BRACKETS:
+        if weight_kg <= max_kg:
+            return prices[zone_index - 1]
+    raise AssertionError("unreachable")  # guarded by the weight check above
+
+
+def shipping_cost(order: dict) -> float:
+    """Return the shipping price in dollars for ``order``, rounded to 2 decimals."""
+    country = order["country"]
+    weight_kg = float(order["weight_kg"])
+    subtotal = float(order["subtotal"])
+    express = bool(order.get("express", False))
+    fragile = bool(order.get("fragile", False))
+    hazmat = bool(order.get("hazmat", False))
+    remote = bool(order.get("remote", False))
+    tier = order.get("tier")
+
+    zone = _zone(country)
+
+    if hazmat and zone == "intl":
+        raise ValueError("hazmat not allowed")
+
+    base = _base_price(weight_kg, zone)
+
+    # Free shipping: domestic, non-express, subtotal >= 100 -> base is 0.
+    if zone == "domestic" and not express and subtotal >= _FREE_SHIPPING_SUBTOTAL:
+        base = 0.0
+
+    total = base
+
+    if hazmat:  # only reachable for domestic / eu
+        total += 15.0
+
+    if express:
+        total += base * (1.0 if zone == "intl" else 0.5)
+
+    if fragile:
+        total += 5.0
+
+    if remote and zone != "intl":
+        total += 8.0
+
+    if tier is not None:
+        if tier not in _TIER_DISCOUNT:
+            raise ValueError("invalid tier")
+        total *= 1.0 - _TIER_DISCOUNT[tier]
+
+    if 0 < total < _MIN_CHARGE:
+        total = _MIN_CHARGE
+
+    return round(total, 2)

+"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base error for inventory operations."""
+
+
+class UnknownSkuError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when a SKU is not present in the inventory."""
+
+
+class DuplicateSkuError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when adding a SKU that already exists."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    quantity: int = 0
+    unit_price: Decimal = Decimal("0")
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if self.quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity cannot be negative")
+        if self.unit_price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("unit_price cannot be negative")
+        self.unit_price = Decimal(self.unit_price)
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU with stock levels and prices."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def add_item(
+        self,
+        sku: str,
+        name: str,
+        quantity: int = 0,
+        unit_price: Decimal | int | str = Decimal("0"),
+    ) -> Item:
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise DuplicateSkuError(f"SKU already exists: {sku}")
+        item = Item(
+            sku=sku, name=name, quantity=quantity, unit_price=Decimal(unit_price)
+        )
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise UnknownSkuError(f"Unknown SKU: {sku}") from None
+
+    def remove_item(self, sku: str) -> None:
+        self.get(sku)
+        del self._items[sku]
+
+    def restock(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> int:
+        """Add units to stock. Returns the new quantity on hand."""
+        if quantity <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("restock quantity must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += quantity
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> int:
+        """Remove units from stock. Returns the new quantity on hand."""
+        if quantity <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("sell quantity must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if quantity > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"Only {item.quantity} of {sku} in stock, cannot sell {quantity}"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= quantity
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def set_price(self, sku: str, unit_price: Decimal | int | str) -> None:
+        price = Decimal(unit_price)
+        if price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("unit_price cannot be negative")
+        self.get(sku).unit_price = price
+
+    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items whose quantity is at or below the threshold, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= threshold),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value(self) -> Decimal:
+        """Sum of quantity * unit_price across all items."""
+        return sum(
+            (i.unit_price * i.quantity for i in self._items.values()),
+            Decimal("0"),
+        )

+import re
+
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+_INT_RE = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+")
+
+
+def _parse_int(text):
+    if not _INT_RE.fullmatch(text):
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}")
+    return int(text)
+
+
+def _require_key(store, key):
+    if key not in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"no such key: {key}")
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _check_arity(name, args, low, high=None):
+    if high is None:
+        high = low
+    if not (low <= len(args) <= high):
+        raise CommandError(f"wrong number of arguments for {name}")
+
+
+def _cmd_set(args, store):
+    _check_arity("set", args, 2, float("inf"))
+    store[args[0]] = " ".join(args[1:])
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_get(args, store):
+    _check_arity("get", args, 1)
+    return _require_key(store, args[0])
+
+
+def _cmd_del(args, store):
+    _check_arity("del", args, 1)
+    if args[0] in store:
+        del store[args[0]]
+        return "1"
+    return "0"
+
+
+def _cmd_exists(args, store):
+    _check_arity("exists", args, 1)
+    return "1" if args[0] in store else "0"
+
+
+def _adjust(name, args, store, sign):
+    _check_arity(name, args, 1, 2)
+    key = args[0]
+    delta = _parse_int(args[1]) if len(args) == 2 else 1
+    current = _parse_int(store[key]) if key in store else 0
+    new = current + sign * delta
+    store[key] = str(new)
+    return str(new)
+
+
+def _cmd_incr(args, store):
+    return _adjust("incr", args, store, +1)
+
+
+def _cmd_decr(args, store):
+    return _adjust("decr", args, store, -1)
+
+
+def _cmd_append(args, store):
+    _check_arity("append", args, 2, float("inf"))
+    key = args[0]
+    value = store.get(key, "") + " ".join(args[1:])
+    store[key] = value
+    return str(len(value))
+
+
+def _cmd_rename(args, store):
+    _check_arity("rename", args, 2)
+    old, new = args
+    value = _require_key(store, old)
+    if new in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"key exists: {new}")
+    del store[old]
+    store[new] = value
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_swap(args, store):
+    _check_arity("swap", args, 2)
+    a, b = args
+    _require_key(store, a)
+    _require_key(store, b)
+    store[a], store[b] = store[b], store[a]
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_keys(args, store):
+    _check_arity("keys", args, 0, 1)
+    prefix = args[0] if args else ""
+    matches = sorted(k for k in store if k.startswith(prefix))
+    return " ".join(matches) if matches else "(empty)"
+
+
+def _cmd_count(args, store):
+    _check_arity("count", args, 0)
+    return str(len(store))
+
+
+def _cmd_clear(args, store):
+    _check_arity("clear", args, 0)
+    store.clear()
+    return "OK"
+
+
+_COMMANDS = {
+    "set": _cmd_set,
+    "get": _cmd_get,
+    "del": _cmd_del,
+    "exists": _cmd_exists,
+    "incr": _cmd_incr,
+    "decr": _cmd_decr,
+    "append": _cmd_append,
+    "rename": _cmd_rename,
+    "swap": _cmd_swap,
+    "keys": _cmd_keys,
+    "count": _cmd_count,
+    "clear": _cmd_clear,
+}
+
+
+def execute(line, store):
+    """Run one command line against ``store`` and return the result string.
+
+    Raises CommandError for any failure.
+    """
+    words = line.split()
+    if not words:
+        raise CommandError("empty command")
+    raw_name, args = words[0], words[1:]
+    handler = _COMMANDS.get(raw_name.lower())
+    if handler is None:
+        raise CommandError(f"unknown command: {raw_name}")
+    return handler(args, store)

+        quantity: int = 0,
+        reorder_level: int = 0,
+        unit_price: float = 0.0,
+    ) -> Item:
+        if not sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise InventoryError(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+        if quantity < 0 or reorder_level < 0 or unit_price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity, reorder_level and unit_price must be >= 0")
+        item = Item(sku, name, quantity, reorder_level, unit_price)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise UnknownItemError(sku) from None
+
+    def remove_item(self, sku: str) -> None:
+        self.get(sku)
+        del self._items[sku]
+
+    def receive(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Add stock (e.g. a delivery). Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Remove stock (e.g. a sale). Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if amount > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"cannot sell {amount} of {sku}; only {item.quantity} in stock"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def low_stock(self) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items at or below their reorder level, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= i.reorder_level),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value(self) -> float:
+        return sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price for i in self._items.values())
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items

+"""A small key-value command interpreter.
+
+``execute(line, store)`` parses one command line and applies it to ``store``
+(a dict of string keys to string values). It returns the reply as a string
+and raises ``CommandError`` for every error.
+"""
+
+import re
+
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+_INT_RE = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+", re.ASCII)
+
+
+def _parse_int(text):
+    if not _INT_RE.fullmatch(text):
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}")
+    return int(text)
+
+
+def _require_key(store, key):
+    if key not in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"no such key: {key}")
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _check_args(name, args, min_args, max_args=None):
+    if max_args is None:
+        max_args = min_args
+    if not (min_args <= len(args) <= max_args):
+        raise CommandError(f"wrong number of arguments for {name}")
+
+
+def _cmd_set(args, store):
+    _check_args("set", args, 2, float("inf"))
+    store[args[0]] = " ".join(args[1:])
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_get(args, store):
+    _check_args("get", args, 1)
+    return _require_key(store, args[0])
+
+
+def _cmd_del(args, store):
+    _check_args("del", args, 1)
+    if args[0] in store:
+        del store[args[0]]
+        return "1"
+    return "0"
+
+
+def _cmd_exists(args, store):
+    _check_args("exists", args, 1)
+    return "1" if args[0] in store else "0"
+
+
+def _adjust(name, args, store, sign):
+    _check_args(name, args, 1, 2)
+    key = args[0]
+    delta = _parse_int(args[1]) if len(args) == 2 else 1
+    current = _parse_int(store[key]) if key in store else 0
+    result = current + sign * delta
+    store[key] = str(result)
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _cmd_incr(args, store):
+    return _adjust("incr", args, store, +1)
+
+
+def _cmd_decr(args, store):
+    return _adjust("decr", args, store, -1)
+
+
+def _cmd_append(args, store):
+    _check_args("append", args, 2, float("inf"))
+    key = args[0]
+    store[key] = store.get(key, "") + " ".join(args[1:])
+    return str(len(store[key]))
+
+
+def _cmd_rename(args, store):
+    _check_args("rename", args, 2)
+    old, new = args
+    value = _require_key(store, old)
+    if new in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"key exists: {new}")
+    del store[old]
+    store[new] = value
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_swap(args, store):
+    _check_args("swap", args, 2)
+    a, b = args
+    _require_key(store, a)
+    _require_key(store, b)
+    store[a], store[b] = store[b], store[a]
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_keys(args, store):
+    _check_args("keys", args, 0, 1)
+    prefix = args[0] if args else ""
+    matches = sorted(k for k in store if k.startswith(prefix))
+    return " ".join(matches) if matches else "(empty)"
+
+
+def _cmd_count(args, store):
+    _check_args("count", args, 0)
+    return str(len(store))
+
+
+def _cmd_clear(args, store):
+    _check_args("clear", args, 0)
+    store.clear()
+    return "OK"
+
+
+_COMMANDS = {
+    "set": _cmd_set,
+    "get": _cmd_get,
+    "del": _cmd_del,
+    "exists": _cmd_exists,
+    "incr": _cmd_incr,
+    "decr": _cmd_decr,
+    "append": _cmd_append,
+    "rename": _cmd_rename,
+    "swap": _cmd_swap,
+    "keys": _cmd_keys,
+    "count": _cmd_count,
+    "clear": _cmd_clear,
+}
+
+
+def execute(line, store):
+    """Run one command line against ``store`` and return its reply."""
+    words = line.split()
+    if not words:
+        raise CommandError("empty command")
+    name, args = words[0], words[1:]
+    handler = _COMMANDS.get(name.lower())
+    if handler is None:
+        raise CommandError(f"unknown command: {name}")
+    return handler(args, store)

+import pytest
+
+from app.commands import execute
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+
+def run(line, store):
+    return execute(line, store)
+
+
+def fails(line, store, message):
+    with pytest.raises(CommandError) as info:
+        execute(line, store)
+    assert str(info.value) == message
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def store():
+    return {}
+
+
+def test_set_and_get(store):
+    assert run("set k hello", store) == "OK"
+    assert run("get k", store) == "hello"
+
+
+def test_set_joins_words_with_single_spaces(store):
+    run("set k  a   b  c ", store)
+    assert store["k"] == "a b c"
+    assert run("get k", store) == "a b c"
+
+
+def test_set_requires_value(store):
+    fails("set k", store, "wrong number of arguments for set")
+
+
+def test_get_missing_key(store):
+    fails("get nope", store, "no such key: nope")
+
+
+def test_get_wrong_arity(store):
+    fails("get", store, "wrong number of arguments for get")
+    fails("get a b", store, "wrong number of arguments for get")
+
+
+def test_del(store):
+    store["k"] = "v"
+    assert run("del k", store) == "1"
+    assert "k" not in store
+    assert run("del k", store) == "0"
+
+
+def test_exists(store):
+    assert run("exists k", store) == "0"
+    store["k"] = "v"
+    assert run("exists k", store) == "1"
+
+
+def test_incr_default_and_amount(store):

+    assert run("incr n 5", store) == "6"
+    assert run("incr n -10", store) == "-4"
+
+
+def test_decr(store):
+    assert run("decr n", store) == "-1"
+    assert run("decr n 4", store) == "-5"
+
+
+def test_incr_stored_value_not_integer(store):
+    store["n"] = "abc"
+    fails("incr n", store, "not an integer: abc")
+
+
+def test_incr_amount_not_integer(store):
+    fails("incr n 1.5", store, "not an integer: 1.5")
+    fails("decr n x", store, "not an integer: x")
+
+
+def test_incr_wrong_arity(store):
+    fails("incr", store, "wrong number of arguments for incr")
+    fails("decr 1 2 3", store, "wrong number of arguments for decr")
+
+
+def test_append(store):
+    assert run("append k hello world", store) == "11"
+    assert run("append k !", store) == "12"
+    assert run("get k", store) == "hello world!"
+
+
+def test_append_requires_text(store):
+    fails("append k", store, "wrong number of arguments for append")
+
+
+def test_rename(store):
+    store["a"] = "1"
+    assert run("rename a b", store) == "OK"
+    assert store == {"b": "1"}
+
+
+def test_rename_missing_source(store):
+    fails("rename a b", store, "no such key: a")
+
+
+def test_rename_onto_existing(store):
+    store["a"] = "1"
+    store["b"] = "2"
+    fails("rename a b", store, "key exists: b")
+    assert store == {"a": "1", "b": "2"}
+
+
+def test_swap(store):
+    store["a"] = "1"
+    store["b"] = "2"
+    assert run("swap a b", store) == "OK"
+    assert store == {"a": "2", "b": "1"}
+
+
+def test_swap_missing_key(store):
+    store["a"] = "1"
+    fails("swap a b", store, "no such key: b")
+    fails("swap z a", store, "no such key: z")
+
+
+def test_keys(store):
+    assert run("keys", store) == "(empty)"
+    for k in ["b", "ab", "a1", "c"]:
+        store[k] = "x"
+    assert run("keys", store) == "a1 ab b c"
+    assert run("keys a", store) == "a1 ab"
+    assert run("keys z", store) == "(empty)"
+
+
+def test_count_and_clear(store):
+    assert run("count", store) == "0"
+    store["a"] = "1"
+    store["b"] = "2"
+    assert run("count", store) == "2"
+    assert run("clear", store) == "OK"
+    assert store == {}
+    assert run("count", store) == "0"
+
+
+def test_empty_line(store):
+    fails("", store, "empty command")
+    fails("   \t ", store, "empty command")
+
+
+def test_unknown_command_keeps_typed_name(store):
+    fails("Frobnicate x", store, "unknown command: Frobnicate")
+
+
+def test_command_names_case_insensitive(store):
+    assert run("SET k v", store) == "OK"
+    assert run("Get k", store) == "v"
+    assert run("CoUnT", store) == "1"
+
+
+def test_wrong_arity_uses_lowercase_name(store):
+    fails("SET", store, "wrong number of arguments for set")
+    fails("Count extra", store, "wrong number of arguments for count")
+    fails("CLEAR now", store, "wrong number of arguments for clear")

+"""Invoice validation.
+
+`validate_invoice` returns every rule violation as a human-readable string,
+in rule order. It never raises for bad input data.
+"""
+
+import datetime
+import math
+import re
+
+SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = ("USD", "EUR", "GBP")
+MAX_NOTES_LENGTH = 500
+_ISO_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
+
+
+def _is_blank(value):
+    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() == "")
+
+
+def _is_number(value):
+    """True for finite int/float values; bools are excluded."""
+    return (
+        isinstance(value, (int, float))
+        and not isinstance(value, bool)
+        and math.isfinite(value)
+    )
+
+
+def _parse_iso_date(value):
+    """Return a date for a strict YYYY-MM-DD string, otherwise None."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _ISO_DATE_RE.fullmatch(value):
+        return None
+    try:
+        return datetime.date.fromisoformat(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _line_errors(number, line):
+    """Per-line errors (rule 8) for a single line."""
+    if not isinstance(line, dict):
+        line = {}
+    errors = []
+    if _is_blank(line.get("sku")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: missing sku")
+    qty = line.get("qty")
+    if not (isinstance(qty, int) and not isinstance(qty, bool) and qty > 0):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad quantity")
+    price = line.get("price")
+    if not _is_number(price) or price < 0:
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad price")
+    return errors
+
+
+def validate_invoice(invoice):
+    """Validate an invoice dict and return a list of error strings.
+
+    An empty list means the invoice is valid.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
+        invoice = {}
+
+    errors = []
+
+    # 1-2: identity fields
+    if _is_blank(invoice.get("id")):
+        errors.append("missing id")
+    if _is_blank(invoice.get("customer")):
+        errors.append("missing customer")
+
+    # 3: currency
+    if invoice.get("currency") not in SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES:
+        errors.append("unsupported currency")
+
+    # 4-6: dates
+    issued = _parse_iso_date(invoice.get("issued"))
+    if issued is None:
+        errors.append("bad issue date")
+    due = _parse_iso_date(invoice.get("due"))
+    if due is None:
+        errors.append("bad due date")
+    if issued is not None and due is not None and due < issued:
+        errors.append("due before issued")
+
+    # 7-8: lines
+    raw_lines = invoice.get("lines")
+    lines = raw_lines if isinstance(raw_lines, list) else []
+    if not lines:
+        errors.append("no lines")
+
+    lines_ok = True
+    for number, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
+        line_errs = _line_errors(number, line)
+        if line_errs:
+            lines_ok = False
+            errors.extend(line_errs)
+
+    # 9: duplicate skus, reported at their second occurrence
+    seen = set()
+    reported = set()
+    for line in lines:
+        if not isinstance(line, dict):
+            continue
+        sku = line.get("sku")
+        if _is_blank(sku) or not isinstance(sku, str):
+            continue
+        if sku in seen:
+            if sku not in reported:
+                errors.append(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+                reported.add(sku)
+        else:
+            seen.add(sku)
+
+    # 10: tax rate
+    tax_rate = invoice.get("tax_rate")
+    tax_ok = True
+    if tax_rate is not None:
+        if not _is_number(tax_rate) or not (0 <= tax_rate <= 0.5):
+            tax_ok = False
+            errors.append("bad tax rate")
+
+    # 11: total, only when every line and the tax rate are valid
+    if "total" in invoice and invoice["total"] is not None and lines_ok and tax_ok:
+        rate = tax_rate if tax_rate is not None else 0
+        subtotal = sum(line["qty"] * line["price"] for line in lines)
+        expected = round(subtotal * (1 + rate), 2)
+        total = invoice["total"]
+        if not _is_number(total) or total != expected:
+            errors.append("total mismatch")
+
+    # 12: notes length
+    notes = invoice.get("notes")
+    if isinstance(notes, str) and len(notes) > MAX_NOTES_LENGTH:
+        errors.append("notes too long")
+
+    return errors

+from app.invoices import validate_invoice
+
+
+def valid_invoice(**overrides):
+    invoice = {
+        "id": "INV-1",
+        "customer": "Acme",
+        "currency": "USD",
+        "issued": "2026-01-10",
+        "due": "2026-02-10",
+        "lines": [
+            {"sku": "A", "qty": 2, "price": 10.0},
+            {"sku": "B", "qty": 1, "price": 5},
+        ],
+    }
+    invoice.update(overrides)
+    return invoice
+
+
+def test_valid_invoice_has_no_errors():
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice()) == []
+
+
+def test_missing_id():
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(id="")) == ["missing id"]
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(id="   ")) == ["missing id"]
+    invoice = valid_invoice()
+    del invoice["id"]
+    assert validate_invoice(invoice) == ["missing id"]
+
+
+def test_missing_customer():
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(customer=" ")) == ["missing customer"]
+    invoice = valid_invoice()
+    del invoice["customer"]
+    assert validate_invoice(invoice) == ["missing customer"]
+
+
+def test_unsupported_currency():
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(currency="JPY")) == ["unsupported currency"]
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(currency="usd")) == ["unsupported currency"]
+    invoice = valid_invoice()
+    del invoice["currency"]
+    assert validate_invoice(invoice) == ["unsupported currency"]
+
+
+def test_bad_issue_date():
+    for value in [
+        "2026-02-30",
+        "2026-1-05",
+        "10/01/2026",
+        "",
+        None,
+        20260110,
+        "2026-13-01",
+    ]:
+        assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(issued=value)) == ["bad issue date"], (
+            value
+        )
+    invoice = valid_invoice()
+    del invoice["issued"]
+    assert validate_invoice(invoice) == ["bad issue date"]
+
+
+def test_bad_due_date():
+    for value in ["2026-00-10", "soon", "2026-02-29", None]:
+        assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(due=value)) == ["bad due date"], value
+
+
+def test_leap_day_is_valid():
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(issued="2024-02-29", due="2024-03-01")) == []
+
+
+def test_due_before_issued():
+    result = validate_invoice(valid_invoice(issued="2026-03-01", due="2026-02-01"))
+    assert result == ["due before issued"]
+
+
+def test_due_before_issued_not_reported_when_a_date_is_bad():
+    result = validate_invoice(valid_invoice(issued="bad", due="2026-02-01"))
+    assert result == ["bad issue date"]
+
+
+def test_same_day_is_not_before():
+    assert validate_invoice(valid_invoice(issued="2026-01-10", due="2026-01-10")) == []
+
+

+"""A small in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base error for inventory operations."""
+
+
+class DuplicateSKUError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when adding an item whose SKU already exists."""
+
+
+class UnknownSKUError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when an operation references a SKU that does not exist."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    price_cents: int
+    quantity: int = 0
+    reorder_level: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if self.price_cents < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price_cents must be non-negative")
+        if self.quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
+        if self.reorder_level < 0:
+            raise ValueError("reorder_level must be non-negative")
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU: stock levels, prices, and low-stock alerts."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def add_item(
+        self,
+        sku: str,
+        name: str,
+        price_cents: int,
+        quantity: int = 0,
+        reorder_level: int = 0,
+    ) -> Item:
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise DuplicateSKUError(f"SKU already exists: {sku}")
+        item = Item(sku, name, price_cents, quantity, reorder_level)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise UnknownSKUError(f"Unknown SKU: {sku}") from None
+
+    def remove_item(self, sku: str) -> None:
+        self.get(sku)
+        del self._items[sku]
+
+    def restock(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Increase stock by `amount`. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("restock amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Decrease stock by `amount`. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("sell amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if amount > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"Only {item.quantity} of {sku} on hand, cannot sell {amount}"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def set_price(self, sku: str, price_cents: int) -> None:
+        if price_cents < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price_cents must be non-negative")
+        self.get(sku).price_cents = price_cents
+
+    def low_stock(self) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items whose quantity is at or below their reorder level, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= i.reorder_level),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value_cents(self) -> int:
+        return sum(i.price_cents * i.quantity for i in self._items.values())
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items

+"""Shipping cost calculation."""
+
+from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
+
+_EU_COUNTRIES = {"DE", "FR", "ES", "IT", "NL"}
+
+# (max weight kg, price) per zone, in ascending weight order
+_BANDS = {
+    "domestic": [(0.5, 4), (2, 7), (5, 12), (20, 25)],
+    "eu": [(0.5, 9), (2, 15), (5, 24), (20, 48)],
+    "intl": [(0.5, 14), (2, 24), (5, 40), (20, 80)],
+}
+
+_TIER_DISCOUNT = {None: Decimal("0"), "silver": Decimal("0.05"), "gold": Decimal("0.10")}
+_CENT = Decimal("0.01")
+
+
+def _zone(country):
+    if country == "US":
+        return "domestic"
+    if country in _EU_COUNTRIES:
+        return "eu"
+    return "intl"
+
+
+def _base_price(zone, weight_kg):
+    if weight_kg <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid weight")
+    if weight_kg > 20:
+        raise ValueError("too heavy")
+    for max_kg, price in _BANDS[zone]:
+        if weight_kg <= max_kg:
+            return price
+    raise ValueError("too heavy")  # pragma: no cover - guarded above
+
+
+def shipping_cost(order):
+    """Return the shipping price in dollars for ``order``, rounded to 2 decimals."""
+    zone = _zone(order["country"])
+    weight = order["weight_kg"]
+    subtotal = order["subtotal"]
+    express = bool(order.get("express", False))
+    fragile = bool(order.get("fragile", False))
+    hazmat = bool(order.get("hazmat", False))
+    remote = bool(order.get("remote", False))
+    tier = order.get("tier")
+
+    if tier not in _TIER_DISCOUNT:
+        raise ValueError("invalid tier")
+
+    base = Decimal(_base_price(zone, weight))
+
+    if hazmat and zone == "intl":
+        raise ValueError("hazmat not allowed")
+
+    # Free shipping: domestic, not express, subtotal >= 100 -> base is 0.
+    if zone == "domestic" and not express and subtotal >= 100:
+        base = Decimal(0)
+
+    total = base
+
+    if express:
+        total += base * (Decimal(1) if zone == "intl" else Decimal("0.5"))
+
+    if fragile:
+        total += Decimal(5)
+
+    if hazmat:
+        total += Decimal(15)  # only reachable for domestic/eu here
+
+    if remote and zone in ("domestic", "eu"):
+        total += Decimal(8)
+
+    total *= 1 - _TIER_DISCOUNT[tier]
+
+    total = total.quantize(_CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+    if 0 < total < 3:
+        total = Decimal(3)
+
+    return float(total)

+# Minimum charge

+"""Simple in-memory gradebook for teachers.
+
+Students are identified by a unique ID. Assignments have a maximum point
+value and a weight. A student's course average is the weighted mean of their
+percentage scores over the assignments that have been graded; assignments
+without a recorded score are ignored.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(Exception):
+    """Raised for invalid gradebook operations."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+    weight: float = 1.0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.name.strip():
+            raise GradebookError("assignment name must not be empty")
+        if self.max_points <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("max_points must be positive")
+        if self.weight <= 0:
+            raise GradebookError("weight must be positive")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Student:
+    student_id: str
+    name: str
+    # assignment name -> points earned (None means no score recorded)
+    scores: dict[str, float | None] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+
+class Gradebook:
+    def __init__(
+        self, letter_scale: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE
+    ) -> None:
+        self._students: dict[str, Student] = {}
+        self._assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = {}
+        self._letter_scale = tuple(
+            sorted(letter_scale, key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True)
+        )
+
+    # --- roster and assignments -------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student_id: str, name: str) -> None:
+        if not student_id:
+            raise GradebookError("student_id must not be empty")
+        if student_id in self._students:
+            raise GradebookError(f"student {student_id!r} already exists")
+        self._students[student_id] = Student(student_id, name)
+
+    def remove_student(self, student_id: str) -> None:
+        self._get_student(student_id)
+        del self._students[student_id]
+
+    def add_assignment(self, name: str, max_points: float, weight: float = 1.0) -> None:
+        if name in self._assignments:
+            raise GradebookError(f"assignment {name!r} already exists")
+        assignment = Assignment(name, max_points, weight)
+        self._assignments[name] = assignment
+
+    def students(self) -> list[Student]:
+        return sorted(self._students.values(), key=lambda s: s.name)
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    # --- scores -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(
+        self, student_id: str, assignment_name: str, points: float | None
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record points earned. Pass None to clear a score."""
+        student = self._get_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        if points is not None:
+            if points < 0:
+                raise GradebookError("points must not be negative")
+            if points > assignment.max_points:
+                raise GradebookError(
+                    f"points {points} exceed maximum {assignment.max_points} "
+                    f"for {assignment_name!r}"
+                )
+        student.scores[assignment_name] = points
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_name: str) -> float | None:
+        student = self._get_student(student_id)
+        self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        return student.scores.get(assignment_name)
+
+    # --- grades -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def assignment_average(self, assignment_name: str) -> float | None:
+        """Mean percentage on one assignment across graded students."""
+        assignment = self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        percents = [
+            s.scores[assignment_name] / assignment.max_points * 100
+            for s in self._students.values()
+            if s.scores.get(assignment_name) is not None
+        ]
+        return sum(percents) / len(percents) if percents else None
+
+    def student_average(self, student_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Weighted percentage average over graded assignments.
+
+        Returns None if the student has no graded assignments.
+        """
+        student = self._get_student(student_id)
+        total_weight = 0.0
+        weighted_sum = 0.0
+        for name, points in student.scores.items():
+            if points is None:
+                continue
+            assignment = self._assignments[name]
+            weighted_sum += (points / assignment.max_points) * 100 * assignment.weight
+            total_weight += assignment.weight
+        if total_weight == 0:
+            return None
+        return weighted_sum / total_weight
+
+    def class_average(self) -> float | None:
+        """Mean of student averages, ignoring students with no graded work."""
+        averages = [
+            avg
+            for sid in self._students
+            if (avg := self.student_average(sid)) is not None
+        ]
+        return sum(averages) / len(averages) if averages else None
+
+    def letter_grade(self, percent: float | None) -> str | None:
+        if percent is None:
+            return None
+        for threshold, letter in self._letter_scale:
+            if percent >= threshold:
+                return letter
+        return self._letter_scale[-1][1]
+
+    def report(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, float | None, str | None]]:
+        """Rows of (student_id, name, percent, letter) sorted by name."""
+        rows = []
+        for student in self.students():
+            avg = self.student_average(student.student_id)
+            rows.append((student.student_id, student.name, avg, self.letter_grade(avg)))
+        return rows
+
+    # --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _get_student(self, student_id: str) -> Student:
+        try:
+            return self._students[student_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown student {student_id!r}") from None
+
+    def _get_assignment(self, name: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self._assignments[name]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise GradebookError(f"unknown assignment {name!r}") from None

+"""Shipping cost calculation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
+
+EU_COUNTRIES = frozenset({"DE", "FR", "ES", "IT", "NL"})
+
+# Weight upper bounds (kg) and the matching base prices per zone.
+WEIGHT_BANDS = (0.5, 2, 5, 20)
+BASE_PRICES = {
+    "domestic": (4, 7, 12, 25),
+    "eu": (9, 15, 24, 48),
+    "intl": (14, 24, 40, 80),
+}
+
+HAZMAT_SURCHARGE = 15
+FRAGILE_SURCHARGE = 5
+REMOTE_SURCHARGE = 8
+FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD = 100
+TIER_DISCOUNTS = {"silver": 0.05, "gold": 0.10}
+MINIMUM_CHARGE = 3
+
+
+def _zone(country: str) -> str:
+    if country == "US":
+        return "domestic"
+    if country in EU_COUNTRIES:
+        return "eu"
+    return "intl"
+
+
+def _base_price(zone: str, weight_kg: float) -> float:
+    if weight_kg <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid weight")
+    if weight_kg > WEIGHT_BANDS[-1]:
+        raise ValueError("too heavy")
+    for limit, price in zip(WEIGHT_BANDS, BASE_PRICES[zone]):
+        if weight_kg <= limit:
+            return price
+    # Unreachable: the bounds check above covers all remaining weights.
+    raise ValueError("too heavy")
+
+
+def shipping_cost(order: dict) -> float:
+    """Return the shipping price in dollars for ``order``, rounded to 2 decimals."""
+    country = order["country"]
+    weight_kg = order["weight_kg"]
+    subtotal = order["subtotal"]
+    express = bool(order.get("express", False))
+    fragile = bool(order.get("fragile", False))
+    hazmat = bool(order.get("hazmat", False))
+    remote = bool(order.get("remote", False))
+    tier = order.get("tier")
+
+    zone = _zone(country)
+
+    if tier is not None and tier not in TIER_DISCOUNTS:
+        raise ValueError("invalid tier")
+    if hazmat and zone == "intl":
+        raise ValueError("hazmat not allowed")
+
+    base = _base_price(zone, weight_kg)
+
+    # Rule 7: free base shipping for non-express domestic orders over the threshold.
+    if zone == "domestic" and not express and subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD:
+        base = 0
+
+    total = base
+
+    if hazmat:  # zone is domestic or eu here
+        total += HAZMAT_SURCHARGE
+
+    if express:
+        total += base * (1.0 if zone == "intl" else 0.5)
+
+    if fragile:
+        total += FRAGILE_SURCHARGE
+
+    if remote and zone != "intl":
+        total += REMOTE_SURCHARGE
+
+    if tier is not None:
+        total *= 1 - TIER_DISCOUNTS[tier]
+
+    if 0 < total < MINIMUM_CHARGE:
+        total = MINIMUM_CHARGE
+
+    return float(Decimal(repr(total)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

+
+
+def test_gold_discount():

+
+
+def test_tier_discount_applies_after_all_surcharges():

+    assert (
+        shipping_cost(order(hazmat=True, fragile=True, remote=True, tier="silver"))
+        == 33.25
+    )
+    assert (
+        shipping_cost(order(hazmat=True, fragile=True, remote=True, tier="gold"))
+        == 31.5
+    )
+
+
+def test_invalid_tier_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid tier"):
+        shipping_cost(order(tier="platinum"))
+
+
+# Minimum charge and rounding
+def test_zero_total_stays_zero():
+    assert shipping_cost(order(subtotal=100.0)) == 0
+
+
+def test_result_is_rounded_to_two_decimals():
+    result = shipping_cost(order(express=True, tier="silver"))
+    assert result == round(result, 2)
+    assert result == 9.98  # 9.975 rounds half-up

+"""A small in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base error for inventory operations."""
+
+
+class UnknownItemError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when a SKU is not in the inventory."""
+
+
+class DuplicateItemError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when adding a SKU that already exists."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    quantity: int = 0
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU and their on-hand quantities."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def add_item(self, sku: str, name: str, quantity: int = 0) -> Item:
+        if not sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("initial quantity must be non-negative")
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise DuplicateItemError(f"item {sku!r} already exists")
+        item = Item(sku=sku, name=name, quantity=quantity)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise UnknownItemError(f"no item with sku {sku!r}") from None
+
+    def receive(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Add ``amount`` units to stock. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def remove(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Remove ``amount`` units from stock. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if amount > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"cannot remove {amount} of {sku!r}; only {item.quantity} on hand"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
+        return self.get(sku).quantity
+
+    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items whose quantity is at or below ``threshold``, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= threshold),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NoteStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def default_store_path() -> Path:
+    """Return the notes file path, honouring the NOTES_FILE env var."""
+    return Path(os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE", DEFAULT_PATH))
+
+
+def _format_note(note: Note, full: bool = False) -> str:
+    if not full:
+        return f"{note.id:>4}  {note.title}"
+    lines = [
+        f"id:      {note.id}",
+        f"title:   {note.title}",
+        f"created: {note.created}",
+        f"updated: {note.updated}",
+        "",
+        note.body,
+    ]
+    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notes", description="A simple notes app.")
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p.add_argument("title")
+    p.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("edit", help="change a note's title or body")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p.add_argument("-t", "--title")
+    p.add_argument("-b", "--body")
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("search", help="find notes containing text")
+    p.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def run(argv: Sequence[str], store: NoteStore, out=sys.stdout, err=sys.stderr) -> int:
+    """Execute a command against ``store``. Returns a process exit code."""
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(list(argv))
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"added note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.list()
+            if not notes:
+                print("no notes", file=out)
+            for note in notes:
+                print(_format_note(note), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note(store.get(args.id), full=True), end="", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "edit":
+            if args.title is None and args.body is None:
+                print("error: nothing to edit; pass --title and/or --body", file=err)
+                return 2
+            note = store.update(args.id, title=args.title, body=args.body)
+            print(f"updated note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"deleted note {args.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            matches = store.search(args.query)
+            if not matches:
+                print("no matches", file=out)
+            for note in matches:
+                print(_format_note(note), file=out)
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {args.id}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    if argv is None:
+        argv = sys.argv[1:]
+    return run(argv, NoteStore(default_store_path()))
