+"""Note storage backed by a JSON file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created: str
+    updated: str
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """A collection of notes persisted to a JSON file.
+
+    The file is created on first write. A missing file is treated as empty.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]):
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the store.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    # -- operations --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        now = _now()
+        note = Note(id=next_id, title=title, body=body, created=now, updated=now)
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def update(
+        self, note_id: int, *, title: str | None = None, body: str | None = None
+    ) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for note in notes:
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                if title is not None:
+                    title = title.strip()
+                    if not title:
+                        raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+                    note.title = title
+                if body is not None:
+                    note.body = body
+                note.updated = _now()
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
+        notes = self._load()
+        remaining = [n for n in notes if n.id != note_id]
+        if len(remaining) == len(notes):
+            raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+        self._save(remaining)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        needle = query.lower()
+        return [
+            n
+            for n in self.list()
+            if needle in n.title.lower() or needle in n.body.lower()
+        ]

+"""Shipping cost calculation."""
+
+# Weight tiers: (max_kg, domestic, eu, intl)
+_BASE_PRICES = (
+    (0.5, 4, 9, 14),
+    (2, 7, 15, 24),
+    (5, 12, 24, 40),
+    (20, 25, 48, 80),
+)
+
+_EU_COUNTRIES = {"DE", "FR", "ES", "IT", "NL"}
+_TIER_DISCOUNTS = {"silver": 0.05, "gold": 0.10}
+
+
+def _zone(country: str) -> str:
+    if country == "US":
+        return "domestic"
+    if country in _EU_COUNTRIES:
+        return "eu"
+    return "intl"
+
+
+def _base_price(weight: float, zone: str) -> int:
+    if weight <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid weight")
+    if weight > 20:
+        raise ValueError("too heavy")
+    column = {"domestic": 1, "eu": 2, "intl": 3}[zone]
+    for max_kg, *prices in _BASE_PRICES:
+        if weight <= max_kg:
+            return prices[column - 1]
+    raise ValueError("too heavy")  # pragma: no cover - guarded above
+
+
+def _base_for_order(order: dict, zone: str, express: bool) -> float:
+    """Base price after free-shipping rule."""
+    base = float(_base_price(order["weight_kg"], zone))
+    # Free shipping: domestic, not express, subtotal >= 100 -> base is 0.
+    if zone == "domestic" and not express and order["subtotal"] >= 100:
+        base = 0.0
+    return base
+
+
+def _surcharges(base: float, zone: str, flags: dict) -> float:
+    """Sum of surcharges for hazmat, express, fragile and remote."""
+    extra = 0.0
+    if flags["hazmat"]:  # intl is rejected earlier, so this is domestic/eu
+        extra += 15
+    if flags["express"]:
+        extra += base * (1.0 if zone == "intl" else 0.5)
+    if flags["fragile"]:
+        extra += 5
+    if flags["remote"] and zone in ("domestic", "eu"):
+        extra += 8
+    return extra
+
+
+def _apply_tier(total: float, tier) -> float:
+    if tier is None:
+        return total
+    if tier not in _TIER_DISCOUNTS:
+        raise ValueError("invalid tier")
+    return total * (1 - _TIER_DISCOUNTS[tier])
+
+
+def shipping_cost(order: dict) -> float:
+    """Return the shipping price in dollars for ``order``, rounded to 2 decimals."""
+    zone = _zone(order["country"])
+    flags = {
+        name: bool(order.get(name, False))
+        for name in ("express", "fragile", "hazmat", "remote")
+    }
+
+    base = _base_for_order(order, zone, flags["express"])
+    if flags["hazmat"] and zone == "intl":
+        raise ValueError("hazmat not allowed")
+
+    total = base + _surcharges(base, zone, flags)
+    total = _apply_tier(total, order.get("tier"))
+
+    if 0 < total < 3:
+        total = 3.0
+    return round(total, 2)

+"""Validation rules for invoice dicts."""
+
+import math
+import re
+from datetime import date
+
+CURRENCIES = ("USD", "EUR", "GBP")
+MAX_NOTES_LENGTH = 500
+_ISO_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
+
+
+def _is_blank_or_missing(value) -> bool:
+    return not isinstance(value, str) or value.strip() == ""
+
+
+def _is_number(value) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
+
+
+def _parse_date(value) -> date | None:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _ISO_DATE_RE.fullmatch(value):
+        return None
+    try:
+        return date.fromisoformat(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _line_errors(number: int, line) -> list[str]:
+    errors = []
+    if not isinstance(line, dict):
+        line = {}
+    if _is_blank_or_missing(line.get("sku")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: missing sku")
+    qty = line.get("qty")
+    if not (isinstance(qty, int) and not isinstance(qty, bool) and qty > 0):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad quantity")
+    price = line.get("price")
+    if not (_is_number(price) and math.isfinite(price) and price >= 0):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad price")
+    return errors
+
+
+def validate_invoice(invoice) -> list[str]:
+    """Return every rule violation for ``invoice`` (empty list means valid).
+
+    Never raises for malformed data; a non-dict invoice is treated as empty.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
+        invoice = {}
+    errors: list[str] = []
+
+    # 1-2: identifiers
+    if _is_blank_or_missing(invoice.get("id")):
+        errors.append("missing id")
+    if _is_blank_or_missing(invoice.get("customer")):
+        errors.append("missing customer")
+
+    # 3: currency
+    if invoice.get("currency") not in CURRENCIES:
+        errors.append("unsupported currency")
+
+    # 4-6: dates
+    issued = _parse_date(invoice.get("issued"))
+    due = _parse_date(invoice.get("due"))
+    if issued is None:
+        errors.append("bad issue date")
+    if due is None:
+        errors.append("bad due date")
+    if issued is not None and due is not None and due < issued:
+        errors.append("due before issued")
+
+    # 7-8: lines
+    lines = invoice.get("lines")
+    if not isinstance(lines, list) or len(lines) == 0:
+        errors.append("no lines")
+        lines = []
+    all_lines_valid = True
+    for number, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
+        line_errs = _line_errors(number, line)
+        if line_errs:
+            all_lines_valid = False
+        errors.extend(line_errs)
+
+    # 9: duplicate skus, reported once at their second occurrence
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    reported: set[str] = set()
+    for line in lines:
+        sku = line.get("sku") if isinstance(line, dict) else None
+        if _is_blank_or_missing(sku):
+            continue
+        if sku in seen:
+            if sku not in reported:
+                reported.add(sku)
+                errors.append(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+        else:
+            seen.add(sku)
+
+    # 10: tax rate
+    tax_rate = invoice.get("tax_rate")
+    tax_ok = True
+    if tax_rate is not None:
+        if not (
+            _is_number(tax_rate) and math.isfinite(tax_rate) and 0 <= tax_rate <= 0.5
+        ):
+            tax_ok = False
+            errors.append("bad tax rate")
+    effective_tax = tax_rate if tax_rate is not None else 0
+
+    # 11: total
+    total = invoice.get("total")
+    if total is not None and lines and all_lines_valid and tax_ok:
+        subtotal = sum(line["qty"] * line["price"] for line in lines)
+        expected = round(subtotal * (1 + effective_tax), 2)
+        if not (_is_number(total) and total == expected):
+            errors.append("total mismatch")
+
+    # 12: notes
+    notes = invoice.get("notes")
+    if isinstance(notes, str) and len(notes) > MAX_NOTES_LENGTH:
+        errors.append("notes too long")
+
+    return errors

+"""Shipping cost calculation."""
+
+DOMESTIC = "domestic"
+EU = "eu"
+INTL = "intl"
+
+EU_COUNTRIES = {"DE", "FR", "ES", "IT", "NL"}
+
+# (max weight kg, price) per zone, ascending by weight.
+BASE_PRICES = {
+    DOMESTIC: [(0.5, 4), (2, 7), (5, 12), (20, 25)],
+    EU: [(0.5, 9), (2, 15), (5, 24), (20, 48)],
+    INTL: [(0.5, 14), (2, 24), (5, 40), (20, 80)],
+}
+
+TIER_DISCOUNTS = {"silver": 0.05, "gold": 0.10}
+
+MIN_CHARGE = 3
+
+
+def _zone(country):
+    if country == "US":
+        return DOMESTIC
+    if country in EU_COUNTRIES:
+        return EU
+    return INTL
+
+
+def _base_price(zone, weight_kg):
+    if weight_kg <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid weight")
+    for max_weight, price in BASE_PRICES[zone]:
+        if weight_kg <= max_weight:
+            return price
+    raise ValueError("too heavy")
+
+
+def _is_free_base(zone, express, subtotal):
+    # Rule 7: domestic, non-express, subtotal >= 100 ships the base for free.
+    return zone == DOMESTIC and not express and subtotal >= 100
+
+
+def _surcharges(zone, base, express, fragile, hazmat, remote):
+    total = 0
+    # Rule 3: hazmat (domestic and eu only; intl is rejected by the caller).
+    if hazmat:
+        total += 15
+    # Rule 4: express adds 50% of base (100% for intl).
+    if express:
+        total += base * (1.0 if zone == INTL else 0.5)
+    # Rule 5: fragile.
+    if fragile:
+        total += 5
+    # Rule 6: remote (ignored for intl).
+    if remote and zone in (DOMESTIC, EU):
+        total += 8
+    return total
+
+
+def shipping_cost(order):
+    """Return the shipping price in dollars for ``order``, rounded to 2 decimals."""
+    country = order["country"]
+    weight_kg = float(order["weight_kg"])
+    subtotal = float(order["subtotal"])
+    express = bool(order.get("express", False))
+    fragile = bool(order.get("fragile", False))
+    hazmat = bool(order.get("hazmat", False))
+    remote = bool(order.get("remote", False))
+    tier = order.get("tier")
+
+    if tier is not None and tier not in TIER_DISCOUNTS:
+        raise ValueError("invalid tier")
+
+    zone = _zone(country)
+
+    if hazmat and zone == INTL:
+        raise ValueError("hazmat not allowed")
+
+    base = _base_price(zone, weight_kg)
+    if _is_free_base(zone, express, subtotal):
+        base = 0
+
+    total = base + _surcharges(zone, base, express, fragile, hazmat, remote)
+
+    # Rule 8: tier discount on the total after all surcharges.
+    if tier is not None:
+        total *= 1 - TIER_DISCOUNTS[tier]
+
+    # Rule 9: minimum charge when the total is positive.
+    if 0 < total < MIN_CHARGE:
+        total = MIN_CHARGE
+
+    return round(total, 2)

+"""Validation rules for invoice dicts.
+
+validate_invoice never raises for bad data: it returns a list of error
+strings, empty when the invoice is valid.
+"""
+
+import math
+import re
+from datetime import date
+
+CURRENCIES = ("USD", "EUR", "GBP")
+MAX_NOTES_LENGTH = 500
+
+_ISO_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
+
+
+def _is_blank(value):
+    return not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip()
+
+
+def _is_int(value):
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
+
+
+def _is_number(value):
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return False
+    return not (isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value))
+
+
+def _parse_date(value):
+    """Return a date for a strict YYYY-MM-DD string, otherwise None."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _ISO_DATE_RE.fullmatch(value):
+        return None
+    year, month, day = (int(part) for part in value.split("-"))
+    try:
+        return date(year, month, day)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _line_errors(number, line):
+    errors = []
+    if _is_blank(line.get("sku")):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: missing sku")
+    qty = line.get("qty")
+    if not (_is_int(qty) and qty > 0):
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad quantity")
+    price = line.get("price")
+    if not _is_number(price) or price < 0:
+        errors.append(f"line {number}: bad price")
+    return errors
+
+
+def validate_invoice(invoice):
+    """Return every rule violation in `invoice`, in rule order."""
+    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
+        invoice = {}
+    errors = []
+
+    # 1-2: identity fields
+    if _is_blank(invoice.get("id")):
+        errors.append("missing id")
+    if _is_blank(invoice.get("customer")):
+        errors.append("missing customer")
+
+    # 3: currency
+    if invoice.get("currency") not in CURRENCIES:
+        errors.append("unsupported currency")
+
+    # 4-6: dates
+    issued = _parse_date(invoice.get("issued"))
+    if issued is None:
+        errors.append("bad issue date")
+    due = _parse_date(invoice.get("due"))
+    if due is None:
+        errors.append("bad due date")
+    if issued is not None and due is not None and due < issued:
+        errors.append("due before issued")
+
+    # 7-9: lines
+    lines = invoice.get("lines")
+    lines_valid = True
+    if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
+        errors.append("no lines")
+        lines_valid = False
+    else:
+        items = [line if isinstance(line, dict) else {} for line in lines]
+
+        # 8: per-line checks
+        for number, line in enumerate(items, start=1):
+            line_errs = _line_errors(number, line)
+            if line_errs:
+                lines_valid = False
+                errors.extend(line_errs)
+
+        # 9: duplicate skus, reported at their second occurrence
+        counts = {}
+        for line in items:
+            sku = line.get("sku")
+            if _is_blank(sku):
+                continue
+            counts[sku] = counts.get(sku, 0) + 1
+            if counts[sku] == 2:
+                errors.append(f"duplicate sku: {sku}")
+
+    # 10: tax rate
+    tax_rate = 0
+    tax_valid = True
+    if "tax_rate" in invoice:
+        candidate = invoice["tax_rate"]
+        if _is_number(candidate) and 0 <= candidate <= 0.5:
+            tax_rate = candidate
+        else:
+            tax_valid = False
+            errors.append("bad tax rate")
+
+    # 11: total, only checkable when every line and the tax rate are valid
+    if "total" in invoice and lines_valid and tax_valid:
+        total = invoice["total"]
+        try:
+            subtotal = sum(line["qty"] * line["price"] for line in items)
+            expected = round(subtotal * (1 + tax_rate), 2)
+        except OverflowError:
+            expected = None
+        if expected is None or not _is_number(total) or total != expected:
+            errors.append("total mismatch")
+
+    # 12: notes length
+    notes = invoice.get("notes")
+    if isinstance(notes, str) and len(notes) > MAX_NOTES_LENGTH:
+        errors.append("notes too long")
+
+    return errors

@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+"""Command interpreter for a simple key-value store backed by a dict."""
+
+import re
+
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+_INT_RE = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+")
+
+# Argument count limits per command: (min, max); max None means unlimited.
+_ARITY = {
+    "set": (2, None),
+    "get": (1, 1),
+    "del": (1, 1),
+    "exists": (1, 1),
+    "incr": (1, 2),
+    "decr": (1, 2),
+    "append": (2, None),
+    "rename": (2, 2),
+    "swap": (2, 2),
+    "keys": (0, 1),
+    "count": (0, 0),
+    "clear": (0, 0),
+}
+
+
+def _parse_int(text):
+    if not _INT_RE.fullmatch(text):
+        raise CommandError(f"not an integer: {text}")
+    return int(text)
+
+
+def _require_key(store, key):
+    if key not in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"no such key: {key}")
+    return store[key]
+
+
+def _cmd_set(args, store):
+    key, *words = args
+    store[key] = " ".join(words)
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_get(args, store):
+    return _require_key(store, args[0])
+
+
+def _cmd_del(args, store):
+    if args[0] in store:
+        del store[args[0]]
+        return "1"
+    return "0"
+
+
+def _cmd_exists(args, store):
+    return "1" if args[0] in store else "0"
+
+
+def _adjust(args, store, sign):
+    key = args[0]
+    delta = _parse_int(args[1]) if len(args) == 2 else 1
+    current = _parse_int(store[key]) if key in store else 0
+    new = current + sign * delta
+    store[key] = str(new)
+    return str(new)
+
+
+def _cmd_incr(args, store):
+    return _adjust(args, store, +1)
+
+
+def _cmd_decr(args, store):
+    return _adjust(args, store, -1)
+
+
+def _cmd_append(args, store):
+    key, *words = args
+    value = store.get(key, "") + " ".join(words)
+    store[key] = value
+    return str(len(value))
+
+
+def _cmd_rename(args, store):
+    old, new = args
+    _require_key(store, old)
+    if new in store:
+        raise CommandError(f"key exists: {new}")
+    store[new] = store.pop(old)
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_swap(args, store):
+    a, b = args
+    _require_key(store, a)
+    _require_key(store, b)
+    store[a], store[b] = store[b], store[a]
+    return "OK"
+
+
+def _cmd_keys(args, store):
+    prefix = args[0] if args else ""
+    matches = sorted(k for k in store if k.startswith(prefix))
+    return " ".join(matches) if matches else "(empty)"
+
+
+def _cmd_count(args, store):
+    return str(len(store))
+
+
+def _cmd_clear(args, store):
+    store.clear()
+    return "OK"
+
+
+_HANDLERS = {
+    "set": _cmd_set,
+    "get": _cmd_get,
+    "del": _cmd_del,
+    "exists": _cmd_exists,
+    "incr": _cmd_incr,
+    "decr": _cmd_decr,
+    "append": _cmd_append,
+    "rename": _cmd_rename,
+    "swap": _cmd_swap,
+    "keys": _cmd_keys,
+    "count": _cmd_count,
+    "clear": _cmd_clear,
+}
+
+
+def execute(line, store):
+    """Run one command line against `store` and return the result string.
+
+    Raises CommandError for any invalid input.
+    """
+    words = line.split()
+    if not words:
+        raise CommandError("empty command")
+
+    raw_name, args = words[0], words[1:]
+    name = raw_name.lower()
+    if name not in _HANDLERS:
+        raise CommandError(f"unknown command: {raw_name}")
+
+    low, high = _ARITY[name]
+    if len(args) < low or (high is not None and len(args) > high):
+        raise CommandError(f"wrong number of arguments for {name}")
+
+    return _HANDLERS[name](args, store)

@@ -0,0 +1,239 @@
+import pytest
+
+from app.commands import execute
+from app.errors import CommandError
+
+
+def run(line, store):
+    return execute(line, store)
+
+
+def err(line, store):
+    with pytest.raises(CommandError) as exc:
+        execute(line, store)
+    return str(exc.value)
+
+
+# --- parsing and dispatch -------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_empty_line_is_error():
+    assert err("", {}) == "empty command"
+    assert err("   \t ", {}) == "empty command"
+
+
+def test_unknown_command_uses_name_as_typed():
+    assert err("Frobnicate x", {}) == "unknown command: Frobnicate"
+
+
+def test_command_names_are_case_insensitive():
+    store = {}
+    assert run("SET a 1", store) == "OK"
+    assert run("Get a", store) == "1"
+    assert run("COUNT", store) == "1"
+
+
+def test_extra_whitespace_is_ignored():
+    store = {}
+    assert run("  set   k    hello   world  ", store) == "OK"
+    assert store == {"k": "hello world"}
+
+
+def test_wrong_arity_message_is_lowercase_name():
+    assert err("GET", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for get"
+    assert err("get a b", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for get"
+    assert err("SET k", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for set"
+    assert err("count x", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for count"
+    assert err("clear x", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for clear"
+    assert err("rename a", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for rename"
+    assert err("swap a b c", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for swap"
+    assert err("incr a 1 2", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for incr"
+    assert err("keys a b", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for keys"
+    assert err("append k", {}) == "wrong number of arguments for append"
+
+
+# --- set / get / del / exists ---------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_set_and_get():
+    store = {}
+    assert run("set name Ada Lovelace", store) == "OK"
+    assert store == {"name": "Ada Lovelace"}
+    assert run("get name", store) == "Ada Lovelace"
+
+
+def test_set_overwrites():
+    store = {"k": "old"}
+    run("set k new", store)
+    assert store == {"k": "new"}
+
+
+def test_get_missing_key():
+    assert err("get nope", {}) == "no such key: nope"
+
+
+def test_del_existing_and_missing():
+    store = {"a": "1"}
+    assert run("del a", store) == "1"
+    assert store == {}
+    assert run("del a", store) == "0"
+
+
+def test_exists():
+    store = {"a": "x"}
+    assert run("exists a", store) == "1"
+    assert run("exists b", store) == "0"
+
+
+def test_keys_are_case_sensitive():
+    store = {"Key": "v"}
+    assert run("exists key", store) == "0"
+    assert err("get key", store) == "no such key: key"
+
+
+# --- incr / decr -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_incr_default_and_explicit_step():
+    store = {}
+    assert run("incr n", store) == "1"
+    assert run("incr n", store) == "2"
+    assert run("incr n 10", store) == "12"
+    assert store == {"n": "12"}
+
+
+def test_decr_default_and_explicit_step():
+    store = {}
+    assert run("decr n", store) == "-1"
+    assert run("decr n 4", store) == "-5"
+    assert run("incr n 5", store) == "0"
+
+
+def test_incr_negative_step():
+    store = {"n": "10"}
+    assert run("incr n -3", store) == "7"
+
+
+def test_incr_stored_value_with_sign_and_leading_zeros():
+    store = {"n": "+007"}
+    assert run("incr n", store) == "8"
+
+
+def test_incr_stored_value_not_integer():
+    store = {"n": "abc"}
+    assert err("incr n", store) == "not an integer: abc"
+    assert store == {"n": "abc"}
+
+
+def test_incr_step_not_integer():
+    store = {}
+    assert err("incr n x", store) == "not an integer: x"
+    assert err("decr n 1.5", store) == "not an integer: 1.5"
+    assert store == {}
+
+
+def test_incr_rejects_non_ascii_digits_and_underscores():
+    assert err("incr n 1_000", {}) == "not an integer: 1_000"
